rows.title: Process and Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Process and Data AnalystHR Technology and Change | London, hybrid£45k – 60k base plus bonus plus benefits
This is a process and data role. The work sits inside an AI programme, and you will end up understanding a lot about how AI operates If you are the person who actually maps the process, finds the seventeen exceptions nobody documented, and works out which of them matter, keep reading.
The role
• Our client is rebuilding how its HR function works, moving from people navigating systems to asking questions in plain language and getting reliable answers back.• You will map HR processes end to end, capturing decision points, roles involved and exception handling.• You will run data quality assessments, work out root causes, and get issues fixed at source rather than patched afterwards.• You will document standards and definitions, maintain the process library, and flag where a process is too vague or inconsistent to automate safely.•The function is being built now, and you will help write the playbook, not inherit one.
What we need you to have done
• Process mapping, hands on. Non-negotiable. Real processes, in a real organisation, to a proper level of detail, working directly with the people who own them.• Minimum two years in a process analyst, business analyst, data analyst or similar role.• Experience working with sensitive information and stakeholders across a business. HR is ideal but not required. Finance, risk, legal, operations or any confidential-data function counts.• Comfort with data: spotting quality problems, tracing where they come from, tracking them through to a fix.
Helpful, not essential
• HR or HR systems exposure (Workday, ServiceNow, SuccessFactors or similar)• Hands-on experience with AI tooling, automation or agents• Process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma or similar)• Data governance frameworks• Agile delivery experience
What you get
• Real ownership of a domain that matters.• Genuine exposure to how AI is being deployed responsibly at enterprise scale, from the inside.• A team that expects you to move around it over time, across HR technology, delivery and reporting, rather than stay in one lane.

rows.title: Data & Digital Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as as a Data & Digital Analyst to take your career to the next level with a global market leader.

How You Will Create An Impact

You will support the design, delivery and adoption of data and digital capabilities across the business. This role sits at the intersection of business need, product thinking and platform delivery, working across Talbot’s core data and digital landscape.

The role is responsible for helping the business translate operational, analytical and strategic needs into practical, scalable data and digital solutions. It plays a critical bridge function between underwriting, operations and other business stakeholders and the platform teams, ensuring that solutions are well scoped, aligned to strategy, operationally viable and adopted by the business.

This role supports a complex and evolving digital and data landscape that includes:


Talisman as the enterprise data platformSpectrum / Underwriting Workbench as key underwriting and operational toolingOngoing transformation work across digital and pricing capabilityData initiatives supporting reporting, controls, performance management and operational insightBusiness enablement and adoption across multiple stakeholder groups

Key responsibilities


Work closely with underwriting, operations, finance, actuarial, pricing and broader business stakeholders to understand pain points, priorities and opportunities for digitisation and data improvement.Translate business needs into clear requirements, solution options, process impacts and delivery-ready user stories or specification documents.Support product and solution shaping across the Talbot data and digital portfolio, including underwriting workflows, data integration, reporting, operational processes and platform capabilities.Partner with platform teams and delivery partners to assess feasibility, prioritise scope, define dependencies and support implementation planning.Help shape and prioritise the backlog across multiple streams of work, balancing near-term business need with longer-term strategic goals.Support design and governance activities for various change initiativesEnsure solutions are aligned to business needs, platform architecture, risk and control requirements, and market operating standards.Provide functional oversight of delivery progress, working with teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues and maintain focus on business value.Support adoption of data and digital products by working with stakeholders to improve data literacy, define training needs and ensure business readiness.Act as a business proxy within data and digital discussions, helping technology teams understand the operational context and helping business teams understand delivery constraints and trade-offs.Monitor and report on product adoption, usage and effectiveness, helping to continuously improve value realisation.

What You'll Need To Succeed


Experience in a data, digital, product or business analysis role within insuranceLloyd’s / London market experience desirableStrong understanding of underwriting processes, operational workflows and how digital and data capabilities support them.Experience working with business stakeholders to understand needs and shape practical solutions.Ability to translate business problems into requirements, user stories, process models and solution options.Strong understanding of data platforms, reporting, workflow tools and digital transformation in a business context.Experience supporting or influencing delivery across cross-functional teams, including technology, platform, operations and business stakeholders.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy Benefits That Take Care Of What Matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

rows.title: Data Analyst - 8 Month FTC
rows.descriptionText:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Data is a key asset to Allica and is deeply embedded in all our teams and products. With data, we assist and work with Finance, Operations, Credit Risk, Product and management.

We are looking for ambitious and curious people who can help us understand our data better, contribute to facilitating the discussions between engineering and the data stakeholders and have an impact on the business by telling stories around the insights they generate.

You will be an integral part of the newly formed business intelligence team, building and developing the analytics and insights capabilities of the Bank.

Role Description

Data is a key asset to Allica and is deeply embedded in all our teams and products. With data, we assist and work with Finance, Operations, Credit Risk, Product and management.

We are looking for ambitious and curious people who can help us understand our data better, contribute to facilitating the discussions between engineering and the data stakeholders and have an impact on the business by telling stories around the insights they generate.

You will be an integral part of the newly formed business intelligence team, building and developing the analytics and insights capabilities of the Bank.

Principal Accountabilities

Understand our products and processes through the data we have or collectHelp the various stakeholders leverage your knowledge of that data to build reporting that will improve their KPI’sOriginate, maintain and enhance data analytics ETL’s.Build dashboards and reports (Looker)Work with product teams and other stakeholders (Ops, finance, risk, etc) to understand their data needs and deliver their data requests.Develop and maintain data standards, always managing the data libraries and dictionaries, documenting your findings and sharing them both within and outside the data team.Helping us implement a data-driven mindset in the company.

Personal Attributes & Experience

Previous experience working as a data analyst in a start-up or fast-paced organisation.You have a proven track record with SQL and writing querie (GCP/BigQuery Preferred).You have a solid foundation in Python programming or a strong desire to learn with basic knowledge already achieved.You are flexible to adapt quickly to changing priorities within a very dynamic environment and work well with stakeholders across the business.You communicate effectively and are comfortable with translating technical detail into business and commercial language.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

Full onboarding support and continued development opportunitiesOptions for flexible workingRegular social activitiesPension contributionsDiscretionary bonus schemePrivate health coverLife assuranceFamily friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

rows.title: QESH Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
SMT is a leading full-service distribution company specializing in machinery and trucks. Our focus is on providing equipment for the construction, material handling, recycling, and transport industry. Launched in 2010, we have already obtained a significant heritage that dates back to 1946. Our mix of agility and international experience gives us the advantage of a synergetic environment. We are active in large parts of Africa, Belgium & Luxembourg, Great Britain, the Netherlands, and in US.

Job Title: QESH Analyst

Location: Duxford, Cambridgeshire

Salary: Competitive + Benefits

Contract: Full Time, Permanent

At SMT GB, we are committed to driving excellence in Quality, Environment, Safety, Health, and Sustainability across our business. As the exclusive Volvo Construction Equipment dealer in Great Britain, we continue to invest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement.

We're looking for a highly analytical and motivated QESH Analyst to support our national QESH team based in Duxford, Cambridgeshire. This is an exciting opportunity for a graduate or early-career professional with a passion for sustainability, environmental performance, quality improvement, and data-driven decision making.

Working closely with our QESH Manager, Health & Safety Manager, Fleet Manager, and Quality Manager, you will play a key role in supporting business-wide initiatives, reporting performance indicators, and driving continual improvement projects that positively impact our people, customers, and the environment.

Key Responsibilities

Gather, analyse and report QESH and ESG performance data across environmental, quality, fleet, and health & safety activities.Support reporting for key metrics including greenhouse gas emissions, energy consumption, waste, water usage, vehicle performance, customer complaints, incidents, and quality defects.Undertake research and analysis to identify opportunities for business improvement and operational efficiencies.Develop data-driven business cases to support investment and continual improvement initiatives.Assist in the design, implementation, monitoring and verification of QESH improvement projects.Maintain QESH management systems and documentation to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reporting integrity.Produce content and communications for intranet updates, events, training programmes, and awareness campaigns.Support internal audits and external certification audits including ISO 14001, ISO 50001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001 and FORS.Analyse audit findings and performance trends to support ongoing improvement activities.Support supplier management activities, procurement exercises, and business integration projects.Contribute to global sustainability initiatives alongside SMT Group colleagues across Europe, the USA, and Africa.

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll be naturally curious, highly organised, and able to transform complex data into meaningful insights that support business decisions.

You Will Have

A Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Environmental Management, or a related discipline.Strong analytical, reporting, and data-processing skills with excellent attention to detail.Advanced IT skills and confidence using databases, reporting tools, and business systems.Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.Excellent organisational, administrative, numeracy, and literacy skills.A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and problem solving.A genuine interest in environmental performance, quality management, and health & safety.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

Master's degree in an Environmental, Sustainability, or related discipline.Membership of ISEP (Institute of Sustainability & Environmental Professionals) or a similar professional body.Experience working with management systems or certification standards.Previous exposure to ESG, sustainability reporting, or continuous improvement projects.

What We Offer

At SMT GB, we recognise that our people are key to our success. In return for your skills and commitment, we offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, development, and long-term career progression.

Competitive salary and company pension schemeHealthcare cash plan, life assurance, and Employee Assistance ProgrammeOngoing training, professional development, and career progression opportunitiesCycle to Work scheme and a range of employee discounts

Applications & Closing Date

We review applications as they are received and reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a sufficient number of suitable applications. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Our values

Our way of working as a professional community, can be best described as Caring, Daring and Sharing. Caring because we are service-minded, and we always like to go the extra mile for our customers and give our people the attention and care they deserve. Daring because we are innovative in our business, constantly looking for smart improvement. And finally Sharing because we realize we’re doing this together; with our clients, with a great team of skilled specialists, excellent manufacturers and reliable suppliers. These values create an engaging environment for passionate people who like to work in a place with purpose.

SMT does not accept unsolicited CVs or applications from headhunters, recruitment agencies, selection agencies, or any other third party, unless prior written consent has been given by SMT. These parties are not permitted to submit CVs or applications to SMT or its employees in any form, including, but not limited to, email, social media or online platforms, whether directly or indirectly.

Any CVs or applications submitted in breach of this policy will be treated as unsolicited and will not create any obligation for SMT. SMT will not acknowledge or accept any claim for compensation, costs or fees arising from such submissions. SMT also expressly reserves the right to contact any candidates directly, without this creating any obligation towards the party that submitted their details

rows.title: Customer Insights and Activation Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally-minded individuals with a passion for fashion. 
If you enjoy working in a creative, fast-paced environment, then #korscareers would love to hear from you! 
"I feel really lucky to be surrounded by such a great team. I’m not only grateful that they’ve helped me achieve my goals, but also that I can give them a place where they can achieve theirs." - Michael Kors - 
Job Title: Customer Insights and Activation Analyst Reports to: Senior Manager, Customer Analytics Division: Michael Kors Location: London 
We have an exciting opportunity for a Customer Insights and Activation Analyst in our London office:

What You’ll Do  This role combines customer analysis, hands-on SQL data work, and driving customer audience strategy. You will play a key role in bridging data and marketing working closely with a wide range of stakeholders across Brand, Digital Marketing, Customer retention, and Clienteling to turn customer data into actionable marketing activity. 
Using SQL and Amperity (CDP) you will extract, shape and validate customer data, turning insights into targeted campaign audiences, and continuously refining those audiences based on performance and behaviour. You will transform complex data into clear insights which will help teams understand what’s happening and why. 
This role requires someone who is confident working directly with data and equally comfortable partnering with different teams, and who treats data accuracy and logic as non-negotiable. 

Customer Analytics & Insights  Analyse customer behaviour, engagement and purchase patterns to identify actionable insights Work with wider analytics team on deeper analysis (e.g. segmentation, propensity modelling inputs) Work with business teams to define audiences based on data-driven logic (e.g. lifecycle, value, propensity signals) that drive revenue or engagement Evaluate campaign performance and provide clear recommendations to improve targeting and ROI Support A/B testing design and measurement 
Data Activation (CDP super user) Translate marketing briefs into clear, actionable audience definitions Build, manage and execute customer segments within the CDP (Amperity) for use across email, paid media, and clienteling Use SQL to define, validate and QA audience selections before activation Ensure all customer selections are accurate, compliant, and aligned with marketing requirements (preferences, opt-outs, GDPR) Own segment naming conventions, taxonomy, and governance Support business teams with testing suggestions and best practice Work with legal and IT security departments on setting up connectors between CDP and external partners when needed 
Data & Technical Execution Understanding data landscapes and implication on data availability and accuracy Write and maintain clean, efficient SQL queries to extract and manipulate customer data from Snowflake and CDP Perform data validation and QA checks to ensure accuracy of all outputs used in marketing Troubleshoot data discrepancies across CDP, source systems and reporting outputs Drive best practices in data handling, documentation, and query structuring 
Stakeholder Collaboration Partner with Brand, Digital, Retention, Stores and other marketing teams to understand objectives and translate them into a data-driven solutions Communicate insights in a clear, actionable way (non-technical audience friendly) Act as a key link between data, analytics, and marketing execution 
What We’re Looking For Solid experience working with customer data and GDP Someone who can own end-to-end delivery: from gathering requirements → insight → presenting results → creating audience → evaluation of results Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to working with data A proactive individual who can work independently and manage multiple priorities A clear communicator who can simplify complex data for business stakeholders Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively across teams 
You’ll Need to Have Solid experience working with customer data and GDP Strong hands-on experience using SQL to query, manipulate and validate large datasets (this is essential) Advanced PowerPoint skills Advanced Excel skills Hands-on experience creating customer segments / audiences for campaigns Excellent attention to detail, with a strong focus on data accuracy and governance Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights 

MK Perks  A purpose-driven workplace where you can grow your career, enjoy flexible benefits, and be part of a culture built on inclusion, impact, and recognition. 
Career Growth Clear paths for progression, leadership opportunities, and mentorship programs to help you thrive. 
Work-Life Balance & Flexibility Support for your well-being with flexible work options and generous time-off policies. 
Culture & Belonging Be part of a culture that champions fairness, fosters belonging, and provides opportunities for everyone to grow and reach their full potential. 
Exclusive Employee Perks Enjoy discounts on premium products and luxury brands. 
Impact & Social Responsibility Contribute to global and local causes through volunteer days, sustainability programs, and charitable giving. 

To know more about working at Michael Kors follow us on LinkedIn and visit our Kors Careers Page

The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories.

rows.title: Insight Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Insight AnalystJob Description

Salary From:£38,000Salary To:£44,000Location:WokingCategory:InsightsContract Type:Permanent Full Time


Insight Analyst

Your next career starts with Acosta Europe.

Client: Pladis

Location: Woking (Hybrid Woking with 3 days in Office)

Contract: Permanent

Start Date : ASAP

At Acosta Europe , people are at the heart of everything we do. As part of one of the world's leading Sales and Marketing agencies, we help some of the biggest brands grow through insight-driven strategies, exceptional execution, and collaborative partnerships.

We are looking for an Insight Analyst to join our team, supporting one of our key clients in a highly visible role that combines data analysis, commercial insight, supply chain collaboration, and stakeholder engagement.

This is an exciting opportunity for a data-driven professional who enjoys turning complex information into actionable recommendations that drive sales, availability, and operational performance.

The Role

As an Insight Analyst , you will work closely with our client, retailer supply chain teams, commercial stakeholders, and field sales teams to generate meaningful insights that improve product availability, stock efficiency, and overall commercial performance.

You will play a crucial role in monitoring stock levels, identifying opportunities, influencing key stakeholders, and providing clear recommendations that help maximise on-shelf availability (OSA), increase retail sales value (RSV), and deliver a strong return on investment (ROI).

Using a variety of data sources and reporting platforms, including the ReApp Insights Platform, you will analyse trends, create impactful reports, and support strategic decision-making across the business.

Key Responsibilities

Insight & Analysis

Analyse commercial and supply chain data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.Generate actionable insights that support improved stock availability and retail performance.Monitor depot and store inventory levels to identify potential supply chain challenges.Produce regular reporting, dashboards, and performance analysis to support business objectives.Translate complex datasets into clear recommendations for stakeholders.


Stakeholder Collaboration

Build strong relationships with internal teams, client stakeholders, retail partners, and supply chain contacts.Attend internal and external meetings to present insights and recommendations.Collaborate with commercial, supply chain, customer service, operations, and field sales teams to improve business performance.Support communication between retailers, field teams, and clients to drive availability improvements.


Supply Chain & Availability

Utilise the ReApp Insights Platform to monitor stock levels and drive availability improvements.Support stock pressure activities to ensure sufficient stock exists within depots and stores.Assist with planning and execution of key events, product launches, and promotional activity.Work with retail supply chain teams to improve on-shelf availability and feature compliance.Identify supply chain efficiencies and lead continuous improvement initiatives.


Reporting & Presentations

Create engaging and visually impactful presentations that communicate insight and recommendations effectively.Deliver clear reports aligned to commercial and field team business cycles.Present findings confidently to both internal and external stakeholders.


What We're Looking For

Experience within an FMCG, supply chain, commercial, analytics, or insights environment.Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret data and provide actionable recommendations.Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and excellent data management capabilities.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.Ability to build credibility and influence decision-makers at all levels.Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.Strong numerical reasoning and problem-solving abilities.Experience creating reports, dashboards, and presentations that drive decision-making.Self-motivated with excellent time management skills.


Why Join Acosta Europe?

Working Environment - Freedom, responsibility and real ownership of your patch whilst working with a globally recognised and trusted brand

Comprehensive Healthcare – medical, dental, vision, plus life insurance and Employee Assistance Programme.

Generous Pension Plan – Growing contributions as your service increases helping you plan for the future.

Paid Time Off – 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays to recharge.

Paid Volunteering Day – Make a difference in your community.

Career Development – access to Acosta University and internal promotion programs.

Company Tools – Including state of the art technology to ensure you are set up for success, including IPad and mobile phone.

Inclusive Culture – supportive, diverse, and values-driven environment.

Employee Engagement – social events, recognition programs, and wellness initiatives.

At Acosta Europe, we believe diversity and inclusion are the foundation of innovation and success. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences, creating a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive. If you're passionate about data, insights, and driving business performance through meaningful analysis, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and take the next step in your career with Acosta Europe.

rows.title: Data Strategy Associate Director
rows.descriptionText:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

2102 - Data Strategy Associate Director - UK

Role Summary and Impact

EssenceMediacom is a new breed of media agency. Grounded in analytics & insights and powered by data & technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. We help clients understand the modern marketing paradox and discover the breakthroughs brands need to win with their consumers. We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data & technology, built for people & algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test & learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.

Data Strategy Associate Director 

EssenceMediacom is seeking a Data Strategy Associate Director to join our growing Data, Technology & Analytics team, reporting into the Data, Tech & Analytics Lead. The team focuses on maximising the value and impact of all data types on a client’s business, and how we effectively measure the performance to help make brands become more valuable to the world.

You will be working with one of the leading retailers in the UK, Boots, to harness their data and improve the performance of their campaigns, developing and deploying media measurement solutions. Communication with client stakeholders and effective management of assigned tasks is critical in this role. You will be joining a team which has doubled in resource over the past 12 months, with an ever-expanding remit to put data at the heart of the marketing function.

Part of The Boots Group, Boots is the UKs authority in beauty, wellness and healthcare with 176 years of trusted heritage and innovation behind it. Boots consistently delivers strong retail and pharmacy sales quarter after quarter in a hugely competitive market. Boots are hungry to keep striving and prioritise great teamwork and true partnership with their agencies to achieve their ambitions.

They are a client who embrace change, encourage innovation, are leaders in data-led planning to fully understand the impact of media in the wider business system and always make time to appreciate achievements and say thank you. They challenge us to deliver world class media planning and activation and enjoy getting recognition for great work we achieve together.

We have invested in giving you the tools to make you as successful as possible, including training/development, full access to relevant tools/platforms and a wider global community of analysts and data scientists.

Role Summary & Impact

Responsible for transforming data into actionable insights that drive superior client outcomes. Data Strategy involves transforming the way our clients think about, organize and orchestrate data & technology to deliver more timely, engaging and meaningful brand experience for their customers. Boots is a data rich client and that combined with clients willingness to test and evolve makes for opportunities to do great work. The Project Lead will optimise audience-driven strategies, identify growth opportunities, and deliver measurable business impact.

Skills And Experience

Data-led audience & bidding strategy and enablement;

Using the data-sets and technology available to Boots, understand the audiences and support in the delivery of test, trial and strategy recommendations across paid media campaigns on addressable channels.Work with internal teams, Boots clients and partner teams to define, justify and request future signals and data products which can drive the clients business goals.

Strategic Project Ownership;

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer, ADAS
rows.descriptionText:
**

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams**

Wayve’s ADAS engineering teams build the perception and intelligence that power driver assistance in real-world driving. We work end-to-end: from creating high-quality training data, to developing and evaluating CV/3D perception models, to iterating quickly based on performance gaps. The team mixes “online” (on-car, latency/compute constrained) and “offline” (heavier, large-scale data generation) work, with a strong focus on measurable impact and shipping.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll train, debug, and improve computer vision and 3D perception models, and iterate based on clear evaluation signals. You’ll work across the full ML lifecycle (data → training → evaluation → iteration), partnering with the team to decide what to tackle next based on where the system is underperforming. A meaningful portion of the role involves building scalable data pipelines (including auto-labelling / pseudo-labelling) to accelerate model development.

🧩 What You’ll Be Working On

You’ll help deliver core ADAS perception capabilities such as detection, classification, and instance segmentation, with domain focus across lanes, objects, traffic signs, and traffic lights. You’ll contribute to offline pipelines like tracking + 3D reconstruction that let us back-propagate “known good” labels through time and generate large labelled datasets. Depending on your strengths, you may lean more into online models that must run fast in-car, or offline models that improve data quality and coverage at scale.

🙌 You Should Apply If

You’ve built and shipped CV-focused deep learning systems and can demonstrate strong applied ML engineering (not research-only). You have experience with 3D perception concepts or pipelines (e.g., LiDAR, multi-view geometry, tracking, 3D reconstruction) and you’re comfortable owning work end-to-end, including evaluation and dataset generation. You enjoy pragmatic problem-solving, working under real product constraints, and you’re excited to improve real-world driving performance through better perception.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More About Wayve

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)Competency Interviews (Programming and System Design 2 hours total) Deep-dive technical interviews (domain-specific interview: 1 hours total)Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve

✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs

📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

About the roleBritish Heart Foundation is investing in Enterprise Foundations, an organisation-wide transformation programme designed to help us become a more customer-centric organisation through new technology, better use of data and more connected ways of working.
As a Digital Journeys Senior Executive, you'll help deliver one of the programme's most significant workstreams: migrating our marketing automation platform from Dotdigital to Adobe and redesigning hundreds of campaigns into customer-centred journeys.
You'll own assigned customer journeys from brief through to delivery, translating journey designs into live Adobe builds and configuring audience segmentation, workflow logic, personalisation and automation. Through rigorous testing and optimisation, you'll help ensure every communication delivers a relevant and connected customer experience.
Working through a series of transformation sprints, you'll contribute to rebuilding and improving existing campaigns while helping establish new standards, processes and ways of working across the organisation. You'll work closely with colleagues across Digital, Data, Retention and Customer Journeys, gaining valuable experience in marketing automation, customer journey orchestration and digital transformation delivery.
Your work will directly influence how we engage audiences and support more people to connect with BHF's mission.
About YouAs our ideal candidate, you'll already have experience designing, building and delivering customer journeys, email campaigns or SMS communications within a marketing automation platform, alongside a strong understanding of audience segmentation, workflow logic and personalisation.
You'll bring strong knowledge of customer journey design, marketing automation and campaign delivery, together with experience using customer data to create relevant, targeted communications. Experience with Adobe Campaign or Adobe Journey Optimizer would be beneficial, but we're equally interested in candidates with experience using platforms such as Dotdigital, Salesforce or Braze who are excited to develop their Adobe expertise.
You'll be confident translating briefs and requirements into live journey builds, using performance insight to identify improvements and working collaboratively with stakeholders across digital, data, technology and marketing teams. Strong attention to detail, testing and quality assurance will be key to your success.
Most importantly, you'll be customer-focused, organised and naturally curious. You'll enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems and finding better ways to create journeys that deliver measurable results.
Working arrangements
These 12-month fixed-term roles provide additional capacity for the Digital Content & Journeys team during the Enterprise Foundations (EF) transformation programme.
These roles will specifically support the migration to Adobe and the building of hundreds of personalised customer journeys through sprint cycles until May 2027, followed by optimisation and hypercare. These roles provide the additional capacity needed to deliver the EF programme’s goals.
As this role is linked to a time-limited transformation programme, it is not intended to form part of BHF's ongoing permanent structure beyond completion of the project and associated optimisation activity. Following completion of the programme, responsibility for the ongoing management and optimisation of journeys will sit within the permanent Digital Content & Journeys team.
The contract is expected to end after 12 months when the additional funded programme activity and associated resourcing requirement are expected to conclude.
This is a hybrid role, where your work will be split between your home and at least one day per week in our London office. This may vary from time to time so you will need to work in a flexible way to unlock your best work for our cause.
Interview process
The interview process will consist of two stages. We plan for first stage interviews will be held over MS Teams on w/c 28 Sep 26 . For those successful, there will be second stage interviews in-person at our London Office (NW1 7AW) on 08 Oct 2026.

Cyber Security Manufacturing Technology Engineer

Help protect the operational technology that keeps modern manufacturing safe, resilient and productive.

Laing O'Rourke's IT function has renewed its strategy to support the company's ambition to transform the construction industry, making it more sustainable, more productive, and fit for the future.

Technology has a critical role to play in achieving this ambition. Our focus is on applying digital capability in ways that genuinely matter, shaping how complex projects are delivered, how decisions are made, and how innovation improves outcomes for people, communities, and the environment.

Our mission is clear: to create a modern and resilient technology environment where trusted data informs every decision, AI enhances every process, and digital capability enables the organisation to operate with greater scale and productivity.

To deliver this, we are building a different kind of IT function, one that is trusted by the business, forward looking in its thinking, and deeply connected to operational outcomes. We are looking for individuals who are curious, thoughtful, and motivated by contributing to work that has real industry impact.

The Role

As our Cyber Security Manufacturing Technology Engineer, you will help protect the operational technology (OT) and industrial control systems (ICS) used across our manufacturing environments. You will shape and maintain practical cyber security controls that support production efficiency, safety and quality, while reducing risk and protecting operational continuity and intellectual property.

Working at the intersection of manufacturing operations, engineering and cyber security, you will embed security into technology and processes from design through to operation. Your judgement and technical expertise will help colleagues understand risk, implement proportionate controls and respond effectively when issues arise.

Key Responsibilities

Design, implement and continually improve cyber security controls for operational technology and manufacturing environments.Collaborate across IT, manufacturing and engineering teams to deliver reliable solutions aligned with architecture and cyber security standards.Assess vulnerabilities in manufacturing systems and equipment, then guide practical remediation or compensating controls that minimise operational disruption.Integrate cyber security requirements into new production lines, industrial equipment and manufacturing systems from the outset.Investigate cyber incidents affecting manufacturing and develop recovery approaches that reduce production downtime and strengthen future resilience.Work with Cyber Security Governance, Risk and Compliance colleagues to improve security across manufacturing suppliers and third-party vendors.Support alignment with relevant frameworks and standards, including IEC 62443, ISO/IEC 27001 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

Essential Requirements

Proven experience developing and implementing cyber security controls and governance in a manufacturing environment.Deep understanding of industrial protocols, network segmentation and vulnerability management for manufacturing equipment.Ability to translate technical and compliance topics into clear, business-relevant language for a range of stakeholders.Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical and risk-based approach to decision-making.Ability to work independently, remain accountable for outcomes and contribute effectively with multidisciplinary colleagues.A clear commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Desirable Requirements

A relevant professional certification, such as GICSP, CISSP or CISM.Knowledge of operational technology cyber security standards, including IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82.Experience working across multidisciplinary teams in a complex organisation.

What Makes This Role Compelling

This is an opportunity to influence cyber security in environments where digital resilience has a direct connection to safe, reliable manufacturing. You will work on meaningful technical challenges, build trusted relationships across operational and technology teams, and help shape security as an enabler of innovation and continuity.

About Laing O'Rourke

Laing O'Rourke is an international engineering and construction business known for pushing boundaries in digital engineering, modern methods of construction and sustainable delivery. With more than 150 years of heritage, we are committed to creating environments in which diverse teams can excel and thrive.

rows.descriptionText:
ABOUT COMPANYSTRAT7 is a data, analytics, and strategy consultancy that helps clients solve complex business challenges. We combine cutting-edge technology with deep industry expertise to deliver actionable insights that drive growth and transformation. As a group, we bring together experts in data science, AI, consumer insight, commercial strategy, and research methods to provide clients with a complete solution to their business challenges. We embrace agile methodologies across our organization, allowing us to respond quickly to changing market conditions and client needs while delivering high-quality solutions efficiently.

POSITION OVERVIEWYou'd be joining Incite's Atlantic Practice, working with major US and global businesses. This isn't a role where you simply keep projects on track. It is genuinely consultative and needs a true problem solver. You'll shape the thinking, advise clients directly, and influence the strategic direction of the work.One of our biggest clients is MetLife – a major US-based financial services company that offer group benefits, insurance, retirement products and other financial services. Every year, MetLife asks a big question: what do working people need to do their best work, and what are employers getting wrong? The answer becomes the Employee Benefit Trends Study (EBTS), one of the most widely cited pieces of thought leadership in the benefits world.The EBTS programme sits at the centre of the role. It's research of the best kind: big questions about how the workplace is changing, genuine involvement in shaping the themes before any fieldwork begins, and findings that get published and quoted rather than filed away. It is about much more than insurance; it is about understanding how human needs are evolving, what businesses need to succeed, and where the world of work is going next.Beyond MetLife, you'll work across other clients as well, spending approximately 70% of your time on MetLife projects and the other 30% on other clients – with many opportunities to solve interesting strategic challenges and make meaningful impact.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESShape Research Questions - co-lead brainstorming sessions to define annual research themes. Design research approach, from questionnaires and discussion guides to innovative methods, ensuring the right question gets asked in the right wayTurn data into Insight - work across quantitative and qualitative evidence to uncover the "so what" in the data. Conduct complex analysis, ensure data reliability, and synthesise large datasets into insights worth publishing. Collaborate with analytics specialists when deeper expertise is neededCraft Compelling Narratives - moving beyond data presentation to narrative impact, ensuring findings are matched by strong storytellingBuild Trusted Client Relationships - manage day-to-day relationships with senior stakeholders, positioning as a solutions-focused trusted advisor. See projects through from kickoff to completion, prepare and run client sessions, and begin developing the longer-term partnership relationshipsContribute to Business Development & Capability - support Principals with content creation for pitches and proposal preparation, help shape how STRAT7 Incite present capabilities and win new work

SKILLS & ATTRIBUTESSolid track record in ad-hoc research or consultancy experience, ideally acquired through an agencyGenuine fluency in both qualitative and quantitative methodologies: comfortable designing questionnaires and discussion guides, and clear-eyed about which approach a problem actually needsAble to run core project elements independently and manage timelinesExcels into uncover insights and clearly communicate their strategic implicationsDemonstrates client relationship management, delivering commercially framed research findings that strengthen trust advisory-led relationshipsPossess a problem‑solving mindset, with the confidence to independently resolve day‑to‑day issues while recognising when to seek supportHas a collaborative approach that supports teamwork and best practiceStrong analytical skills, with hands-on experience of SPSS and multivariate techniques

BENEFITSThe role comes with a competitive salary and clear paths to promotion and to new opportunities. Benefits include:
25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays (Christmas closure – 3 days additional to entitlement – discretionary and non-contractual leave)Flexible, hybrid working options – we expect you to be at the office 3 days a weekA contributory group personal pension scheme, to which we contribute 4% of Qualified Banded earnings to each team member’s gross salary after an initial 3 months service4-week sabbatical after 4 years continuous service on top of 25 days holiday2 volunteering paid days per year (under a formal program for a registered charity)A Health cash planLife assurance scheme at 4 x salaryCycle to work scheme following successful completion of probation

RECRUITMENTRecruitment for this role will involves three interviews
DISCLOSURESTRAT7 is an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences and backgrounds, who share a passion for research. Our commitment to inclusivity is not just about race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one's identity. All of our employee's points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Salary From:£38,000Salary To:£44,000Location:WokingCategory:InsightsContract Type:Permanent Full Time


Insight Analyst

Your next career starts with Acosta Europe.

Client: Pladis

Location: Woking (Hybrid Woking with 3 days in Office)

Contract: Permanent

Start Date : ASAP

At Acosta Europe , people are at the heart of everything we do. As part of one of the world's leading Sales and Marketing agencies, we help some of the biggest brands grow through insight-driven strategies, exceptional execution, and collaborative partnerships.

We are looking for an Insight Analyst to join our team, supporting one of our key clients in a highly visible role that combines data analysis, commercial insight, supply chain collaboration, and stakeholder engagement.

This is an exciting opportunity for a data-driven professional who enjoys turning complex information into actionable recommendations that drive sales, availability, and operational performance.

The Role

As an Insight Analyst , you will work closely with our client, retailer supply chain teams, commercial stakeholders, and field sales teams to generate meaningful insights that improve product availability, stock efficiency, and overall commercial performance.

You will play a crucial role in monitoring stock levels, identifying opportunities, influencing key stakeholders, and providing clear recommendations that help maximise on-shelf availability (OSA), increase retail sales value (RSV), and deliver a strong return on investment (ROI).

Using a variety of data sources and reporting platforms, including the ReApp Insights Platform, you will analyse trends, create impactful reports, and support strategic decision-making across the business.

Key Responsibilities

Insight & Analysis

Analyse commercial and supply chain data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.Generate actionable insights that support improved stock availability and retail performance.Monitor depot and store inventory levels to identify potential supply chain challenges.Produce regular reporting, dashboards, and performance analysis to support business objectives.Translate complex datasets into clear recommendations for stakeholders.


Stakeholder Collaboration

Build strong relationships with internal teams, client stakeholders, retail partners, and supply chain contacts.Attend internal and external meetings to present insights and recommendations.Collaborate with commercial, supply chain, customer service, operations, and field sales teams to improve business performance.Support communication between retailers, field teams, and clients to drive availability improvements.


Supply Chain & Availability

Utilise the ReApp Insights Platform to monitor stock levels and drive availability improvements.Support stock pressure activities to ensure sufficient stock exists within depots and stores.Assist with planning and execution of key events, product launches, and promotional activity.Work with retail supply chain teams to improve on-shelf availability and feature compliance.Identify supply chain efficiencies and lead continuous improvement initiatives.


Reporting & Presentations

Create engaging and visually impactful presentations that communicate insight and recommendations effectively.Deliver clear reports aligned to commercial and field team business cycles.Present findings confidently to both internal and external stakeholders.


What We're Looking For

Experience within an FMCG, supply chain, commercial, analytics, or insights environment.Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret data and provide actionable recommendations.Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and excellent data management capabilities.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.Ability to build credibility and influence decision-makers at all levels.Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.Strong numerical reasoning and problem-solving abilities.Experience creating reports, dashboards, and presentations that drive decision-making.Self-motivated with excellent time management skills.


Why Join Acosta Europe?

Working Environment - Freedom, responsibility and real ownership of your patch whilst working with a globally recognised and trusted brand

Comprehensive Healthcare – medical, dental, vision, plus life insurance and Employee Assistance Programme.

Generous Pension Plan – Growing contributions as your service increases helping you plan for the future.

Paid Time Off – 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays to recharge.

Paid Volunteering Day – Make a difference in your community.

Career Development – access to Acosta University and internal promotion programs.

Company Tools – Including state of the art technology to ensure you are set up for success, including IPad and mobile phone.

Inclusive Culture – supportive, diverse, and values-driven environment.

Employee Engagement – social events, recognition programs, and wellness initiatives.

At Acosta Europe, we believe diversity and inclusion are the foundation of innovation and success. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences, creating a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive. If you're passionate about data, insights, and driving business performance through meaningful analysis, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and take the next step in your career with Acosta Europe.

rows.title: Process and Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Process and Data AnalystHR Technology and Change | London, hybrid£45k – 60k base plus bonus plus benefits
This is a process and data role. The work sits inside an AI programme, and you will end up understanding a lot about how AI operates If you are the person who actually maps the process, finds the seventeen exceptions nobody documented, and works out which of them matter, keep reading.
The role
• Our client is rebuilding how its HR function works, moving from people navigating systems to asking questions in plain language and getting reliable answers back.• You will map HR processes end to end, capturing decision points, roles involved and exception handling.• You will run data quality assessments, work out root causes, and get issues fixed at source rather than patched afterwards.• You will document standards and definitions, maintain the process library, and flag where a process is too vague or inconsistent to automate safely.•The function is being built now, and you will help write the playbook, not inherit one.
What we need you to have done
• Process mapping, hands on. Non-negotiable. Real processes, in a real organisation, to a proper level of detail, working directly with the people who own them.• Minimum two years in a process analyst, business analyst, data analyst or similar role.• Experience working with sensitive information and stakeholders across a business. HR is ideal but not required. Finance, risk, legal, operations or any confidential-data function counts.• Comfort with data: spotting quality problems, tracing where they come from, tracking them through to a fix.
Helpful, not essential
• HR or HR systems exposure (Workday, ServiceNow, SuccessFactors or similar)• Hands-on experience with AI tooling, automation or agents• Process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma or similar)• Data governance frameworks• Agile delivery experience
What you get
• Real ownership of a domain that matters.• Genuine exposure to how AI is being deployed responsibly at enterprise scale, from the inside.• A team that expects you to move around it over time, across HR technology, delivery and reporting, rather than stay in one lane.

rows.descriptionText:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Data is a key asset to Allica and is deeply embedded in all our teams and products. With data, we assist and work with Finance, Operations, Credit Risk, Product and management.

We are looking for ambitious and curious people who can help us understand our data better, contribute to facilitating the discussions between engineering and the data stakeholders and have an impact on the business by telling stories around the insights they generate.

You will be an integral part of the newly formed business intelligence team, building and developing the analytics and insights capabilities of the Bank.

Role Description

Data is a key asset to Allica and is deeply embedded in all our teams and products. With data, we assist and work with Finance, Operations, Credit Risk, Product and management.

We are looking for ambitious and curious people who can help us understand our data better, contribute to facilitating the discussions between engineering and the data stakeholders and have an impact on the business by telling stories around the insights they generate.

You will be an integral part of the newly formed business intelligence team, building and developing the analytics and insights capabilities of the Bank.

Principal Accountabilities

Job Title: QESH Analyst

Location: Duxford, Cambridgeshire

Salary: Competitive + Benefits

Contract: Full Time, Permanent

At SMT GB, we are committed to driving excellence in Quality, Environment, Safety, Health, and Sustainability across our business. As the exclusive Volvo Construction Equipment dealer in Great Britain, we continue to invest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement.

We're looking for a highly analytical and motivated QESH Analyst to support our national QESH team based in Duxford, Cambridgeshire. This is an exciting opportunity for a graduate or early-career professional with a passion for sustainability, environmental performance, quality improvement, and data-driven decision making.

Working closely with our QESH Manager, Health & Safety Manager, Fleet Manager, and Quality Manager, you will play a key role in supporting business-wide initiatives, reporting performance indicators, and driving continual improvement projects that positively impact our people, customers, and the environment.

Gather, analyse and report QESH and ESG performance data across environmental, quality, fleet, and health & safety activities.Support reporting for key metrics including greenhouse gas emissions, energy consumption, waste, water usage, vehicle performance, customer complaints, incidents, and quality defects.Undertake research and analysis to identify opportunities for business improvement and operational efficiencies.Develop data-driven business cases to support investment and continual improvement initiatives.Assist in the design, implementation, monitoring and verification of QESH improvement projects.Maintain QESH management systems and documentation to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reporting integrity.Produce content and communications for intranet updates, events, training programmes, and awareness campaigns.Support internal audits and external certification audits including ISO 14001, ISO 50001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001 and FORS.Analyse audit findings and performance trends to support ongoing improvement activities.Support supplier management activities, procurement exercises, and business integration projects.Contribute to global sustainability initiatives alongside SMT Group colleagues across Europe, the USA, and Africa.

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll be naturally curious, highly organised, and able to transform complex data into meaningful insights that support business decisions.

You Will Have

A Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Environmental Management, or a related discipline.Strong analytical, reporting, and data-processing skills with excellent attention to detail.Advanced IT skills and confidence using databases, reporting tools, and business systems.Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.Excellent organisational, administrative, numeracy, and literacy skills.A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and problem solving.A genuine interest in environmental performance, quality management, and health & safety.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

What We Offer

At SMT GB, we recognise that our people are key to our success. In return for your skills and commitment, we offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, development, and long-term career progression.

Competitive salary and company pension schemeHealthcare cash plan, life assurance, and Employee Assistance ProgrammeOngoing training, professional development, and career progression opportunitiesCycle to Work scheme and a range of employee discounts

Applications & Closing Date

We review applications as they are received and reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a sufficient number of suitable applications. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Our way of working as a professional community, can be best described as Caring, Daring and Sharing. Caring because we are service-minded, and we always like to go the extra mile for our customers and give our people the attention and care they deserve. Daring because we are innovative in our business, constantly looking for smart improvement. And finally Sharing because we realize we’re doing this together; with our clients, with a great team of skilled specialists, excellent manufacturers and reliable suppliers. Job Description

At evoke, our customers are at the centre of everything we do. As part of our Real Time CRM team, you'll play a key role in delivering timely, relevant and engaging communications that enhance every stage of the customer journey. About our client
Our client is a well-established technology and data consultancy supporting enterprise organisations across both the private and public sectors. They partner with clients to modernise legacy systems, extract practical value from complex data, and deploy robust digital solutions.
With steady commercial growth and an open, collaborative team culture, they provide an environment where your work has immediate visibility and measurable impact.
The opportunity
How businesses find technology partners is undergoing a fundamental shift. Potential clients are moving beyond traditional search engines and increasingly turning to AI-driven tools, large language models, and trusted third-party directories to identify potential suppliers.
To stay ahead, our client is investing in their external digital footprint. In this role, you will take lead responsibility for establishing and elevating their presence across authoritative software review platforms, technology marketplaces, and digital touchpoints.
This is a broad, practical position combining platform management, website maintenance, and marketing operations. If you have solid digital fundamentals and want to expand your technical and operational skill set, this role provides the autonomy and training to do so.

Third-party platforms and brand visibility
Manage and build our client's listings on leading B2B technology marketplaces and software comparison sites, including G2, Clutch, and relevant industry directoriesCreate and roll out structured programmes to gather genuine client reviews and testimonialsEnsure company information, service offerings, and product profiles remain accurate and compelling across every external channelTrack lead volume and conversion rates originating from marketplace platforms to evaluate channel return on investment
Website management and performance
Maintain and update the core enterprise website using WordPressImplement practical conversion rate improvements by reviewing user journeys and identifying friction pointsKeep content aligned with search engine optimisation best practices and evolving answer engine discovery principlesReview analytics and performance reports to understand where traffic comes from and where users drop off
Marketing operations and automation
Build and maintain lead-routing workflows and automated lead scoring in HubSpotEnsure inbound interest captured from external platforms passes cleanly to commercial and sales teamsAssist with regular campaign tracking and monthly performance reporting
Operational coordination
Manage operational administration, including processing marketing invoices, tracking vendor renewals, and monitoring subscription budgetsLiaise with external agencies, SEO tool providers, and software partners
What success looks like
Within your first six months, you will have:
Established regular listing updates and a dependable review-generation process across primary marketplace platformsStreamlined lead handoffs in HubSpot so inbound enquiries reach the right teams without delayGained a clear understanding of digital performance data to show which external touchpoints produce the most qualified interest
What you will bring
We are far more interested in your aptitude, curiosity, and drive to learn than in tick-box years of experience. You do not need to have done every part of this role before, as hands-on mentoring and training will be provided from day one.
Essential experience and skills
A solid grounding in B2B digital marketing principles and web fundamentalsPractical experience updating content within a content management system, ideally WordPressPrior exposure to a marketing automation platform such as HubSpot, with an understanding of how data and leads flow through a funnelStrong project management skills, with the discipline to keep multiple tasks organised and on trackClear verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to collaborate with senior colleagues and external suppliersComfort handling practical administrative tasks, including budget tracking and invoice administration
Mindset and approach
A genuine hunger to learn and develop, particularly around how AI tools are changing marketing operations and online discoveryA problem-solving attitude that seeks out solutions and enjoys understanding how systems work behind the scenesA collaborative, dependable working style suited to a close-knit team

Support the Group Commercial Finance Director in the day-to-day management, review and reporting of Group capital planning.Review capex submissions and business cases to ensure they are complete, appropriately supported and aligned with Group policy and approval requirements.Prepare analysis on committed, approved and forecast capex spend, highlighting risks, variances and areas requiring management attention.Support the development and maintenance of capital planning reporting, governance trackers and approval materials.Work with Finance, Development and Operations teams to ensure capex decisions are supported by clear financial analysis and appropriate challenge.

Prepare and review financial models for new site opportunities, refurbishments and development projects.Support the review of key assumptions, including revenue, cost, payroll, rent, capex, working capital and return metrics.Prepare concise summaries of feasibility outputs, sensitivities and key risks for senior stakeholder review.Work with Development, Operations and Finance teams to ensure feasibility models are robust, consistent and clearly documented.Support the assessment of accounting implications linked to new site decisions, including leases, capitalisation and impairment considerations, working with technical accounting teams where required.

Property, Leases and Commercial Agreements

Support financial analysis relating to leases, property costs, rent reviews, lease amendments and other property-related commercial arrangements.Assist in the financial review of JV, HMA and key commercial agreements, ensuring key terms are understood, summarised and reflected in management reporting where relevant.Prepare analysis to support negotiation, renewal or restructuring of commercial agreements.Maintain clear summaries of key obligations, financial commitments and commercial risks across relevant agreements.Work closely with Legal, Property and Finance colleagues to provide timely financial input into commercial decision-making.

Insurance and Claims Support

Support the Group Commercial Finance Director with analysis and reporting relating to insurance programmes, claims and coverage matters.Assist with the preparation and financial support of Business Interruption and Contingent Business Interruption claims.Gather, reconcile and analyse financial information required to support claims preparation and recovery.Work with Operations, Finance and external advisors to ensure claims data is accurate, well evidenced and clearly presented.Help maintain reporting on open claims, recoveries, insurance costs and key risk areas.

Business Partnering

Provide analytical support to the Group Commercial Finance Director in business partnering Soho Works, Residences and other business lines.Prepare monthly performance analysis, commercial insight and decision-support materials for relevant business areas.Support the review of revenue, cost, margin and profitability trends, identifying opportunities to improve performance.Build strong working relationships with operational and functional teams, providing clear, practical and commercially focused finance support.Translate financial analysis into clear commentary and recommendations for non-finance stakeholders.

AI-Enabled Analytics and Process Improvement

Support the use of AI-enabled tools, ERP data and automation to improve the quality, speed and consistency of commercial finance analysis.Help develop repeatable reporting templates, dashboards and analytical outputs across capital planning, feasibility and commercial agreements.Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve data quality and strengthen decision-making through better use of systems and automation.Support process improvements across commercial finance workstreams, ensuring outputs are efficient, controlled and scalable.Maintain strong documentation and version control for key models, reports and governance materials.

Key Skills And Experience

Strong commercial finance, FP&A, investment appraisal or corporate finance experience, ideally gained in a multi-site, hospitality, property, leisure, retail or consumer-facing business.Excellent financial modelling and analytical skills, with experience preparing or reviewing business cases, feasibility models or investment appraisals.Good understanding of capex, leases, property costs and commercial agreements.Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear, concise outputs for senior stakeholders.Experience working with ERP, BI or reporting tools, with an interest in AI-enabled analytics and automation.Strong attention to detail, with the ability to challenge assumptions and identify risks or inconsistencies.Good technical accounting awareness, particularly around leases, capex and capitalisation, with willingness to work closely with technical accounting specialists.Qualified accountant or studying towards ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent would be preferred.Experience in hospitality, property, leisure, retail, membership or multi-site businesses would be advantageous.

Key Competencies

Commercial judgement: Able to interpret financial information in a practical, commercially relevant way and support better business decisions.Analytical rigour: Strong ability to review models, challenge assumptions and produce accurate, well-supported analysis.Stakeholder management: Confident working with Finance, Development, Legal, Operations and other senior stakeholders.Communication: Able to summarise complex financial information clearly and concisely for both finance and non-finance audiences.Ownership: Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple workstreams with limited supervision.Governance and control: Strong focus on accuracy, documentation, process discipline and approval requirements.Change mindset: Comfortable working in a transforming finance function, with interest in improving processes through better data, systems and automation.Team contribution: Collaborative, flexible and willing to support a broad commercial finance agenda as the team evolves.

Desired Profile

The ideal candidate will be a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys working close to the business, reviewing investment decisions, supporting strategic projects and improving the quality of financial insight. They will be comfortable working with detailed models and data, but equally able to step back and explain the key commercial message clearly.

They will need to be hands-on, pragmatic and confident operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. This role would suit someone looking to build broader commercial finance experience across capital planning, property, new site feasibility, insurance, commercial agreements and business partnering within a growing international group.

Benefits…
