rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Loan Boarding & Data Integration team serves as the operational and technical bridge between mortgage origination and servicing, supporting the systems, processes, and data that enable new mortgage products to be successfully onboarded and supported throughout the member lifecycle.

The team operates at the intersection of business operations, technology, and business intelligence. Team members partner with business stakeholders, application engineers, product teams, and operational leaders to develop solutions that improve efficiency, enhance reporting capabilities, and provide visibility into key business outcomes. Through operational reporting, data integration, and data visualization solutions, the team helps Real Estate Lending business units make informed, data-driven decisions.

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical Summer Associate to join our Loan Boarding & Data Integration team. This role is ideal for students interested in business intelligence, data visualization, operational reporting, and financial services. The Summer Associate will work with operational and reporting data to develop meaningful dashboards, visualizations, and performance metrics that support business decision-making and process improvement initiatives.

The Summer Associate Program is a 12-week internship program beginning in May 2027 and ending in August 2027. Students will work on impactful projects and meaningful work during their internship. To qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or later.

Responsibilities

Potential Projects: 

 Operational Reporting & Data Visualization


Objective: Enhance the effectiveness and accessibility of reporting solutions that support Real Estate Lending operations.

Description: Develop dashboards and visualizations that provide insight into reporting utilization, information access patterns, and operational data needs across Real Estate Lending. Analyze reporting trends to identify opportunities for improved reporting effectiveness, reduced duplication of effort, and broader adoption of self-service reporting solutions. Partner with business stakeholders to develop recommendations that improve how operational information is accessed, delivered, and utilized to support decision-making. The Summer Associate will create executive-ready KPI dashboards and present recommendations to business leaders at the conclusion of the internship.

 Loan Boarding Operational Metrics


Objective: Improve visibility into loan onboarding performance and operational efficiency.

Description: Design and develop dashboards that provide insight into loan boarding activity, processing trends, exception volumes, and performance indicators. Identify opportunities to improve reporting transparency and provide actionable insights that support operational decision-making.

 Business Process Visualization


Objective: Support process improvement initiatives through data-driven reporting and visualization

Description: Analyze operational workflows and performance metrics to identify trends, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities. Develop visual reporting solutions that enable stakeholders to monitor performance and measure business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and technology teams to identify reporting and visualization opportunities.Gather, analyze, and interpret operational and business data from multiple systems and sources.Design and develop interactive dashboards, scorecards, and reports using Power BI and other reporting tools.Apply data visualization best practices to communicate key trends, risks, and opportunities effectively.Perform data validation and quality analysis to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.Translate complex datasets into executive-ready presentations and actionable business insights.Support the development of key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics used to monitor business performance.Document reporting requirements, data definitions, and dashboard methodologies.Present findings and recommendations to business and technology stakeholders.Participate in Agile ceremonies, team meetings, and project planning activities.Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency through automation and standardization.Perform other related duties as assigned.


Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.Experience working with Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.Familiarity with data visualization concepts and dashboard design.Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a team environment.Strong organizational and time management skills.Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences.


Desired Qualifications

Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence platforms.Experience with SQL, Python, R, or related analytical tools.Familiarity with financial services, lending, mortgage operations, or banking concepts.Experience creating reports, dashboards, or executive presentations.Experience with KPI development, operational reporting, or business intelligence solutions.Exposure to Agile methodologies and tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO).


What You Will Gain

rows.descriptionText:
Overview

At Navy Federal, Internal Audit’s goal is to provide independent, objective assurance and advisory services designed to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the risk management process. Internal Audit accomplishes its objectives by bringing a systematic, disciplined approach to auditing to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk mitigation across all facets of the business.

Internal Audit includes a diverse range of professionals including certified auditors, subject matter experts who specialize in IT, finance, fraud, regulatory requirements, and data, as well as strategic personnel, all working collaboratively to ensure a seamless experience for Navy Federal and its members.

Navy Federal is growing and the environment in which we operate is rapidly evolving, posing new and unique risks to the enterprise. As a result, Internal Audit must continuously adapt to provide assurance to our business partners through a risk-based approach that evaluates the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and the internal control environment.

The Summer Associate will be a member of the Internal Audit Technology & Analytics Team composed of data analysts and other technology-focused personnel. The team employs quantitative tools and techniques to support strategic initiatives like the expansion of the Continuous Risk Assessment Program, in addition to performing data-driven, 100% population testing on audits.

The Summer Associate will work in a hybrid capacity and report to leadership at our Vienna, VA, Winchester VA or Pensacola, FL campus. Responsibilities could include applying data analysis, dashboarding and reporting skillsets to provide actionable insights to management and executive leadership.

rows.title: Summer Associate Internship (Enterprise Risk - Data Risk Governance)
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Navy Federal’s Enterprise Data Risk Governance (EDRG) team provides independent second-line oversight of data risk across the enterprise. The team develops and maintains the Enterprise Data Governance framework, provides effective challenge, monitors data risk, and supports consistent implementation of data governance requirements.

EDRG’s work focuses on data quality, metadata management, Critical Data Elements (CDEs), data governance, and the identification and management of enterprise data risks. The team partners with Business Units and other stakeholders to assess data management practices, identify risk and control gaps, monitor remediation, and communicate data risk insights to leadership.

The Summer Associate will gain practical experience in enterprise data risk governance through day-to-day activities and a focused project. The role will include research, data analysis, risk assessment, reporting, and collaboration with data governance and risk management stakeholders.

The Summer Associate Program is a 12-week internship program beginning in May 2027 and ending in August 2027. Students will work on impactful projects and meaningful work during their internship. To qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or later.

Responsibilities

Research emerging data risks, regulatory developments, industry practices, and data governance control frameworksSupport reviews of Business Unit practices related to data quality, metadata management, CDEs, data ownership, and data governance requirementsAnalyze data governance documentation, risk assessments, controls, issues, and supporting evidence to identify gaps, trends, and areas requiring further reviewAssist with EDRG effective challenge and oversight activities by documenting observations, recommendations, stakeholder responses, and resulting outcomesSupport monitoring of enterprise data risks, data governance standards, remediation activities, and related risk and performance indicatorsAssist with the development and maintenance of reports, dashboards, metrics, and workflow tracking used to communicate data risk and governance progressPrepare clear summaries, presentations, and supporting materials for EDRG leadership, Business Units, and other risk management stakeholdersCollaborate with team members and enterprise stakeholders on data risk assessments, governance initiatives, process improvements, and other assigned projects


Qualifications

Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Risk Management, Computer Science, Finance, or other related fieldInterest in data governance, data quality, metadata management, enterprise risk management, or regulatory complianceExperience with research, analysis, and organizing information from multiple sourcesFamiliarity with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, or data governance tools is preferredStrong analytical, critical-thinking, written communication, and presentation skillsAbility to communicate technical and risk-related information clearly to technical and non-technical audiencesAbility to manage priorities and work effectively both independently and in a team environment

Our colleagues come from a wide range of backgrounds, business, academia, healthcare, government and nonprofits, and are part of a culture where doing exceptional work and making a meaningful difference for students and society aren't separate goals—they're one and the same. This means creating an environment where colleagues can develop new skills, build careers that match their ambitions and see the tangible impact of their work on healthcare education and workforce development. Colleagues who deliver results and embrace new tools to work smarter are valued for their contributions. But what makes working at Covista distinctive is our impact. Our faculty and colleagues don't just support healthcare education—they shape it. This isn't abstract purpose work. It's solving real problems for real people in real communities while advancing careers.



We operate on a hybrid schedule with four in-office days per week (Monday–Thursday). This approach enhances creativity, innovation, communication, and relationship-building, fostering a dynamic and collaborative work environment.



For more information, visit covista.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

The Business Process Analyst will work closely with Project Managers, functional groups, stakeholders and technical staff to ensure the accuracy and timeliness of data and information in support of projects. Communicates with project teams after UAT execution to inform them of results, including any issues, problems or risks with the process or application. rows.title: Data Annotator
rows.descriptionText:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

About This Role

Produce high-fidelity annotations on imagery and video used to train and evaluate machine learning models. Annotators work to a defined ontology and labeling specification, meet project quality and throughput targets, and operate inside the designated annotation environment for each program. Assignments rotate across projects, modalities, and customers as program needs change.

Key Responsibilities

Label static imagery and video across a range of sensor types, image qualities, and scene conditions, including both real-world and synthetic data.Produce 2D bounding boxes, instance and semantic segmentation masks, and keypoint annotations to project specification.Produce oriented and rotated bounding boxes where scene geometry requires them.Produce 3D and 6 degrees-of-freedom pose, orientation, and scale annotations on projects that require them.Produce multi-object tracking annotations, maintaining consistent object identity across full sequences — through occlusion, frame exit and re-entry, scale change, and camera or platform motion.Review, correct, and accept or reject model-assisted and pre-labeled output; report systematic pre-label failure modes rather than silently correcting the same error frame by frame.Work strictly to the project ontology and guidelines; escalate ambiguous or out-of-ontology objects rather than guessing.Meet assigned accuracy and throughput targets, and hold that standard consistently across large batches.Complete rework promptly from QA feedback, applying the correction to comparable cases in the same batch.Log edge cases and recurring ambiguities so they can be adjudicated and folded into the guidelines.Follow all customer data-handling, confidentiality, and information security requirements for the assigned project, and keep required training current.

Must-Have Qualifications

1+ years of image or video annotation experience, or equivalent precision work in a quality-managed production environment.Working familiarity with at least one professional annotation platform (for example CVAT, V7 Darwin, Labelbox, Scale, or comparable).Practical understanding of bounding boxes, segmentation masks, keypoints, and object tracking — and of what makes each one correct rather than merely present.Strong visual attention to detail and the discipline to hold a standard across tens of thousands of frames.Ability to follow written labeling guidelines exactly, and to ask precise questions when they are silent on a case.Comfortable working in remote-desktop or browser-based environments.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience across multiple annotation modalities rather than a single task type.Experience with aerial, overhead, satellite, or thermal/IR imagery.Experience with long-form video and tracking work.Experience reviewing model-assisted pre-labels in a human-in-the-loop pipeline.Prior work on government or regulated-industry programs.

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $42,000 to $62.500 annually, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Program eligibility: Some programs require eligibility for a government background investigation or credentialing. Assignment to those programs is contingent on meeting those requirements.

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at verifyjoboffer@innodata.com and consider reporting it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

PETADATA is looking for a Senior Documentum Specialist with 15+ years of hands-on experience in Enterprise Content Management (ECM) solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Documentum, OpenText, and related ECM technologies. This role requires deep expertise in Documentum platform customization, integration, migration, and maintenance, as well as the ability to lead and manage complex ECM projects from concept to implementation.

As a Senior Consultant, you will be expected to provide thought leadership, define best practices, and play an active role in the strategic direction of ECM initiatives for our clients.

Documentum Design & Development:

Lead the design, development, and troubleshooting of Documentum applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, and security. Implement best practices for Documentum security, including user roles, permissions, and access controls. 

API Development & Integration

Design and develop REST APIs for Documentum and other ECM platforms, utilizing the Spring Framework. Integrate Documentum with external systems and third-party applications via REST APIs. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to API performance, security, and integration. 

Cloud Expertise & AWS Management

Manage and optimize AWS deployments, review configurations, security policies, and analyze logs to ensure the reliability of cloud-based ECM applications. Troubleshoot and resolve complex cloud infrastructure issues, including system outages, network failures, and performance bottlenecks. 

Agile Methodology & Project Delivery

Lead and contribute to Agile development teams, ensuring adherence to Agile principles and practices. Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and code reviews to maintain high code quality and alignment with project objectives. Collaborate closely with product owners, business analysts, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver on-time, high-quality ECM solutions. 

Client Engagement & Technical Consulting

Serve as the primary technical consultant for clients, translating business needs into technical ECM solutions. Provide high-level support to resolve issues, optimize performance, and ensure long-term scalability of the ECM systems. Deliver technical presentations and documentation to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Required Skills

15+ years of experience working with Documentum and related ECM products (Content Server, D2 Config, D2 Classic, D2 Smart View, Brava, CTS, xPlore, DFC Client). Strong understanding of Documentum architecture, object model, and security. Experience with Documentum platform upgrades and migrations, including version upgrades and data migrations. 2+ years of experience implementing REST APIs using the Spring Framework, preferably for Documentum or similar ECM platforms. 3+ years of experience working with AWS services, including EC2, ECS, RDS, ALB, SSM, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and AWS SDK. Skilled in troubleshooting AWS deployments, reviewing configurations, security policies, and analyzing logs. Experience with OpenText and integrating it with Documentum or other enterprise systems. Experience working in an Agile environment, with a deep understanding of Agile principles and practices (e.g., Scrum, Kanban). Proficient in Java, Documentum Foundation Classes (DFC), SQL, and other relevant programming languages. Solid understanding of enterprise security, including encryption, access controls, and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA). Ability to work independently as well as in a collaborative team environment. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Skills

Certifications in Documentum or AWS are a plus. Experience with cloud-based ECM solutions (e.g., Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage). Familiarity with other ECM platforms like OpenText, Alfresco, or SharePoint. Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines for ECM systems.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

rows.title: Summer Associate Internship (Technical Product Analyst)
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Summer Associate will work in a flexible hybrid manner (3 days per week in office) and report to Marketing leadership at our Vienna, VA campus. This role will be a member of the Marketing Orchestration & Analytics team – a diverse group of analysts focused on developing marketing use cases & strategies, developing system capabilities & operational efficiencies, and understanding the resulting impact to our members and business objectives. Our group fills the critical role of bridging traditional marketing theory and process with 21st Century marketing technology and practice to provide Member Centric Experience and realize Business Value through the Next Best Interaction marketing program.

The Summer Associate on this team will help lead the development of automation and AI solutions to support Marketing business user needs. This role requires technical expertise to support innovative solution design, and advanced problem-solving to lead the development of technology solutions to fill business needs. They will drive solutions to support Marketing business teams, combining analytical and technical skills with an understanding of the systems and processes that support direct marketing efforts through Pega and Salesforce. Direct outcomes will include targeted automation/AI solutions that drive efficiencies in Marketing.

The Summer Associate Program is a 12-week internship program beginning in May 2027 and ending in August 2027. Students will work on impactful projects and meaningful work during their internship. To qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or later.

Responsibilities

Lead collaboration with business users and Marketing leadership, to assess user and program needs and translate into thoughtful solution designs that are aligned with the organization's broader business objectives. Mentor team members on tools and strategies that will enable them to pursue their own automation/AI enhancements that will ensure Perform other related duties as assigned. 


Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in technical field, or the equivalent combination of training, education, and experience; Master's/advanced Degree or certifications preferred. Experience in technology/technology adjacent roles preferred. Understanding of technical, analytical, mathematical/statistical, and AI/Automation concepts like: navigating Data Lake/Data Warehouse, conceptual understanding of API/ETL, familiarity with predictive analytics/models, and proficiency in agentic solution development.Proficiency in tools and environments such as Azure, SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, large language model, and m365 suite of applications.Leads collaboratively with advanced analytical and problem-solving abilities.Knowledge of solution design across multiple tools and techniques and drives automation conceptsMentor others and effectively influences collaboration across teams.Advanced communication skills, with a proven ability to convey complex/technical concepts to and data-driven insights to diverse stakeholders leveraging verbal, written, and presentation mediums.

rows.title: Rating Product Implementation Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Your Impact at GEICO  

We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical associate to join the Rating Product Implementations team. As a Rating Product Implementation Analyst, you will prepare, execute, and implement activities that allow the company to put rate and rule revisions into effect for all lines of business. This role also develops system specifications to accommodate revisions or new items that impact company systems.

How You’ll Make a Difference  

Implementation Support: Support rate and rule revisions across all lines of business. System Specifications: Develop specifications for rating and system changes. Research & Analysis: Assess revision impacts on systems and business processes. Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate requirements and implementation timelines with partner teams. System Change Evaluation: Support testing and review of implemented system changes. Team Contribution: Contribute strong organization, communication, and analytical thinking. 

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Qualifications: 

Analytical mindset with ability to assess system impacts. Ability to support rate and rule revisions. Experience coordinating requirements, timelines, and results. 

Core Skills: 

Strong analytical and detail-oriented approach. Organized and able to manage multiple priorities. Clear verbal and written communication skills. Collaborative, positive, and results-driven. Ability to support implementation timelines. 

Preferred Skills

Insurance filing or compliance experience. Knowledge of P&C rating principles. Ability to translate changes into system requirements. Testing, validation, or post-implementation review experience. Strong documentation and tracking skills. Cross-functional partnership experience. Proficiency with Excel, Word, or SharePoint. 

Education

High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education, training, or comparable professional experience in insurance, regulatory compliance, business operations, or related discipline is preferred. 

Annual Salary

$56,375.00 - $101,475.00

The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The GEICO Pledge

Great Company: Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity.

Great Careers: Personalized development programs, mentorship, and certification assistance.

Great Culture: Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success.

Great Rewards: Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

GEICO hires and promotes individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Brief Description

As a Data Analyst, your focus will be on collecting, analyzing, and interpreting marketing data to inform strategies and decisions for nonprofit clients across diverse channels. This role will give you the insights you need to develop your expertise in omnichannel marketing, nonprofit fundraising, and analytic toolsets.

Moore is a data-driven constituent experience management (CXM) company achieving accelerated growth for clients through integrated supporter experiences across all platforms, channels, and devices. We are an innovation-led company that is the largest marketing, data, and fundraising company in North America, serving the purpose-driven industry with clients across education, association, political, and commercial sectors.

Check out www.WeAreMoore.com for more information.

Your Impact:

Design and maintain comprehensive reports, dashboards, Key Performance Indicators, and other business tools to inform client strategy. Leverage your coding skills to transform data into useable information that can be presented in Power BI, Excel, and/or other reporting tools. Apply technical skills to deploy automated procedures that drive efficient data ingestion and transformation. Identify trends, patterns, and outliers in complex data sets to drive decisions. Work with internal team members to develop deep knowledge of our clients’ programs to produce more relevant analysis and deepen your analytic abilities. Collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy. Identify errors in data files or reports and take measures to resolve them. Perform other duties as required. 


Your Profile: 

Bachelor’s degree 1-3 years’ experience in an analytical role Experience in direct marketing preferred Excellent analytical skills. Effective communication skills. Ability to present findings clearly and concisely. Familiarity with fundraising metrics, file segmentation techniques, and direct marketing strategy. Demonstrated, hands-on experience with SQL and Python; a Snowflake environment a plus. Fundamental understanding of relational database design and reporting systems. Intermediate to advanced users of Excel with strong ability in formulas, functions, and pivot tables. Experience with statistical analysis methods and concepts like randomized controlled trials, hypothesis testing, summary statistics, regression, and other explanatory and predictive modeling frameworks. Experience with direct marketing and attribution across multiple channels, including but not limited to direct mail, website, digital advertising, email, and direct response TV. Attention to detail with the intrinsic ability to identify anomalies, discover the root cause, and correct underlying issues 


How We’ll Support You:

Join the largest marketing and fundraising company in North America serving the nonprofit industry, where we prioritize innovation and professional growth. Collaborate with industry subject matter experts with over 5,000 employees across the enterprise. To help you stay energized, engaged, and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits, including comprehensive healthcare, paid holidays, and generous paid time off so you can have the time and space to recharge and pursue your other passions and be with the people you care about.Moore is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

rows.title: Analyst, Data & Analytics (Johns Hopkins Technology Ventures)
rows.descriptionText:
Johns Hopkins Technology Ventures (JHTV), the university's technology commercialization division, is launching the JHTV Analyst Program, a structured two-year experiential learning opportunity designed for recent graduates interested in innovation, entrepreneurship, healthcare, science, business, law, technology, and public impact.

We are seeking an Analyst, Data & Analytics who will contribute to high-priority strategic initiatives while gaining broad exposure to technology commercialization, startup formation, intellectual property, corporate engagement, venture funding, and innovation management. Through cohort-based learning, professional development programming, executive exposure, cross-functional projects, and mentorship, analysts develop the analytical, communication, and leadership skills that prepare them for graduate study or future careers across the innovation economy.

At the end of the two-year term, Analysts may be considered for open positions within JHTV or the university; however, continuation of employment beyond the term is not guaranteed.

The Analyst, Data & Analytics serves as a central resource for transforming data into actionable insight across JHTV. This individual will help build the tools, systems, and analytical infrastructure that support technology evaluation, commercialization decision-making, business intelligence, and organizational effectiveness.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to support strategic initiatives and organizational priorities.Collect, organize, analyze, and synthesize information from multiple sources to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and recommendations.Develop reports, dashboards, presentations, briefing materials, and executive summaries for operational and strategic decision-making.Support projects involving faculty, university leaders, external partners, and other stakeholders by conducting research, analysis, and developing recommendations.Translate complex information into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.Support business process improvement initiatives and recommend enhancements to tools, systems, workflows, and reporting practices.Maintain accurate records, documentation, trackers, and project materials.Build productive relationships across JHTV and the broader university community.Present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and leadership.Participate in cohort-based onboarding, professional development programming, mentorship opportunities, and cross-functional learning experiences.Contribute to a capstone project and final presentation addressing a strategic opportunity or challenge within JHTV.Support special projects and other duties as assigned.

In addition to duties described above

Aggregate and integrate data assets from university and external sources into scalable analytical resources.Build and maintain dashboards, databases, reporting tools, and decision-support systems.Develop repeatable frameworks for evaluating technologies, opportunities, and commercialization outcomes.Design and support AI-enabled tools and automation solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.Assist with development of internal knowledge management systems and information portals.Create data visualizations and analytical products that communicate insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.Partner with commercialization teams to improve access to information and business intelligence.Analyze data quality, identify gaps, and recommend improvements to data governance practices.Support implementation of new reporting capabilities and analytical workflows.Collaborate with subject matter experts to create tools that improve consistency and efficiency in opportunity assessment.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in a related field.No prior professional experience required.Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

Preferred Qualifications

U.S. Citizen or Legal Permanent Resident required due to Federal Export Controls.Advanced degree in a related field.Three years of related experience.Degree concentration in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field preferred.Experience with data pipelines, databases, or analytical tooling (coursework or projects acceptable).Familiarity with AI/ML tools and applications.Ability to communicate technical work to non-technical audiences.Full-time, in-person role based in Baltimore, MD.Fast-paced environment with variable hours; not a fixed 9-to-5 schedule.

Technical Skills & Expected Level Of Proficiency

Data Management and Analysis - DevelopingBusiness Process Analysis - DevelopingReport Writing - DevelopingPresentations - DevelopingProject Management - DevelopingStakeholder Engagement - DevelopingChange Management - Developing

The core technical skills listed are most essential; additional technical skills may be required based on specific division or department needs.

rows.title: Outreach Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Are you ready to make a meaningful impact on people’s lives?

Join us at Transformations Care Network (TCN), as we embark on an exciting journey to improve access to high-quality behavioral healthcare while raising the standard of care across the communities we serve.

rows.title: Data Scientist I
rows.descriptionText:
Brief Description

Position: Data Scientist I

Location: Alexandria, VA

Work Environment: Onsite

Clearance Required: Secret is required to be considered; the position requires the selected candidate to obtain a TS/SCI if they have not already obtained that level of clearance.

Status: Funded

Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000

Knowesis is looking for a Data Scientist I to support the United States Special Operations Command Preservation of the Force and Family (USSOCOM POTFF) program in identifying and implementing innovative, valuable solutions across the Special Operations Forces (SOF) enterprise aimed at improving the short and long-term well-being of SOF warriors and their families. The Data Scientist I will support all POTFF domains, providing consultation and assistance to supported units and POTFF staff to identify opportunities and methods for capturing data relating to POTFF programs and initiatives.

This position requires a TOP-SECRET/SCI clearance and U.S. Citizenship (applicants without proof of U.S. citizenship will not be considered due to the position’s security clearance requirement). 

This position requires on-site work for all or a portion of the work being performed. The successful candidate will reside in the local area or relocate within 15 days of the start date. No relocation is authorized.

The Job Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following: 

Conducts data analytics, data manipulation, data mining, exploratory analysis, predictive analysis, and statistical analysis, and uses scientific techniques to correlate data into graphical, written, visual, and verbal narrative products, enabling more informed analytic decisions.Enter and analyze data within government systems. Aggregate data sets across numerous applications and develop trend analysis. Create products demonstrating these trends.Modify and update existing data sources to provide relevant program related outcome metrics. Maintain dashboards to automate data analysis, identifying, interpreting, and presenting trends, designed to record POTFF-related programmatic data.Assist the POTFF staff with survey design. Create, analyze, and report survey data.Provide consultation and assistance to supported units and POTFF staff to identify opportunities and methods for capturing data related to POTFF programs and initiatives.Work in consultation with POTFF program staff and the Government’s POTFF biostatistician.Provide subject matter expertise in the areas of program evaluation, research methodologies, and data analysis.Be able to use statistics/modeling tools and data visualization techniques to provide an accessible way to see and understand trends, outliers, and patterns in data to produce reports and presentations that accurately convey data trends supporting the mission.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in quantitative science, social science, or a related discipline.Basic proficiency with the suite of Microsoft Office programs, including Word, Excel, and Access.Basic proficiency with commonly used statistical software applications such as SPSS, SAS, Python, and R-Shiny.Be able to read, write, and speak English fluently and clearly to effectively communicate with all personnel they will interact with.Possess excellent verbal, written, interpersonal communication, presentation skills, and shall be highly detail oriented.Possess sufficient initiative, interpersonal relationship skills, and social sensitivity such that they can relate constructively to a variety of contacts from diverse backgrounds.

Preferred Qualifications 

Certification or documented experience with Human Performance.Experience working with Special Operations, athletics/sports, or other military settings.Strong technical and analytical skills in the following:SQL Server, Databricks, Apache Spark (PySpark), Python, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power AutomateKnowledge of ETL/ELT development, dimensional data modeling, data governance, machine learning, statistical analysis, NLP, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented workflows, and data pipeline orchestration. Experience supporting enterprise analytics, dashboard development, predictive modeling, and low-code automation solutions in Microsoft and cloud-based data environments preferred.
Benefits

 Health (PPO & HDHP) Insurance, Dental, Vision, STD & LTD, Basic Life Insurance, 401k Company Match, & Voluntary Products. 

Knowesis is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals based on merit and qualifications. We prohibit discrimination in all aspects of employment as required by Title VII of the Civil Rights Act and other applicable federal laws. Our company values all applicants and employees and fosters a work environment where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

rows.title: Email Marketing Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
A mission-driven nonprofit media organization is seeking an Email Marketing Specialist to manage its day-to-day email and lifecycle marketing program. This hands-on role will focus on building campaigns, managing automated journeys, analyzing performance, and continuously improving engagement, conversion, retention, and revenue.
What You’ll DoBuild, test, schedule, and deploy promotional, transactional, fundraising, newsletter, and lifecycle email campaigns.Develop automated journeys for onboarding, conversion, renewal, re-engagement, donor cultivation, and win-back.Create campaign landing pages and ensure a consistent experience through conversion.Build targeted audience segments based on behavior, engagement, lifecycle stage, and member or donor history.Conduct A/B testing across subject lines, messaging, creative, calls to action, offers, audiences, and send times.Track campaign performance and translate results into actionable recommendations.Manage campaign QA, deliverability, list health, tracking, and compliance.Coordinate the email calendar across marketing, editorial, development, and membership teams.
What We’re Looking For3+ years of hands-on email, lifecycle, or digital marketing experience.Proficiency with an ESP or marketing automation platform such as Customer.io, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, HubSpot, or Salesforce.Experience building and optimizing email campaigns and automated journeys.Basic HTML/CSS skills for email troubleshooting and landing-page updates.Strong copywriting, editing, analytical, and project-management skills.Experience with Google Analytics or a similar reporting platform.Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
Preferred QualificationsExperience with CRM, CDP, membership, subscriber, or donor data.Background in nonprofit fundraising, subscription media, publishing, or another member-supported organization.Familiarity with landing-page or CMS platforms such as Unbounce, HubSpot, or WordPress.Experience with a right-of-center or mission-driven organization and alignment with conservative principles.

rows.descriptionText:
Brief Description

As a Data Analyst, your focus will be on collecting, analyzing, and interpreting marketing data to inform strategies and decisions for nonprofit clients across diverse channels. This role will give you the insights you need to develop your expertise in omnichannel marketing, nonprofit fundraising, and analytic toolsets.

Moore is a data-driven constituent experience management (CXM) company achieving accelerated growth for clients through integrated supporter experiences across all platforms, channels, and devices. We are an innovation-led company that is the largest marketing, data, and fundraising company in North America, serving the purpose-driven industry with clients across education, association, political, and commercial sectors.

Check out www.WeAreMoore.com for more information.

Your Impact:

Design and maintain comprehensive reports, dashboards, Key Performance Indicators, and other business tools to inform client strategy. Leverage your coding skills to transform data into useable information that can be presented in Power BI, Excel, and/or other reporting tools. Apply technical skills to deploy automated procedures that drive efficient data ingestion and transformation. Identify trends, patterns, and outliers in complex data sets to drive decisions. Work with internal team members to develop deep knowledge of our clients’ programs to produce more relevant analysis and deepen your analytic abilities. Collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy. Identify errors in data files or reports and take measures to resolve them. Perform other duties as required. 


Your Profile: 

Bachelor’s degree 1-3 years’ experience in an analytical role Experience in direct marketing preferred Excellent analytical skills. Effective communication skills. Ability to present findings clearly and concisely. Familiarity with fundraising metrics, file segmentation techniques, and direct marketing strategy. Demonstrated, hands-on experience with SQL and Python; a Snowflake environment a plus. Fundamental understanding of relational database design and reporting systems. Intermediate to advanced users of Excel with strong ability in formulas, functions, and pivot tables. Experience with statistical analysis methods and concepts like randomized controlled trials, hypothesis testing, summary statistics, regression, and other explanatory and predictive modeling frameworks. Experience with direct marketing and attribution across multiple channels, including but not limited to direct mail, website, digital advertising, email, and direct response TV. Attention to detail with the intrinsic ability to identify anomalies, discover the root cause, and correct underlying issues 


How We’ll Support You:

Join the largest marketing and fundraising company in North America serving the nonprofit industry, where we prioritize innovation and professional growth. Collaborate with industry subject matter experts with over 5,000 employees across the enterprise. To help you stay energized, engaged, and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits, including comprehensive healthcare, paid holidays, and generous paid time off so you can have the time and space to recharge and pursue your other passions and be with the people you care about.Moore is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

rows.title: Manager, Data Science
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

The Card DS team is working continuously to innovate the way we handle data to transform every corner of our business through analytics, infrastructure, valuations, and strategy. We build human-centric experiences for moments that matter throughout the customer journey, and we do this by harnessing data, technology, and talent to propel our business forward. To accomplish this goal, we design, build, and maintain the appropriate solutions we use across Card to make smart, informed decisions. We use the latest techniques in machine learning to build predictive models and utilize the advantages of large-scale data and cloud-based processing. Through these techniques, we extract relevant insights from data to tackle a huge variety of business problems.

In this role you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal candidate will be:

Curious and creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions, and you love pushing hard to find the answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences. Technical: You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions from concept to production using open source tools and modern cloud computing platforms. You are not afraid of petabytes of data. Statistically-minded. You have built models, validated them and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series analysis and deep learning. Customer and product oriented. You share our passion for changing banking for good. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analytics3+ years of hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining high-scale, production-grade ML systems using MLOps practices, including AWS, Kubeflow, and CI/CD pipelinesDeep expertise (4+ years) in developing and optimizing state-of-the-art Deep Learning models, specifically Transformer-based architectures, using PyTorch and distributed training with multi-GPU optimizationExtensive experience (4+ years) with high-performance, distributed data processing for petabyte-scale feature engineering using frameworks like DASK and PySpark

WHO WE ARE: At Fors Marsh, we take on issues that matter. We are a team of researchers, strategists, and communicators working together to drive lasting change. We look at human behavior from all angles with a deep understanding of people and context to design solutions that influence decision-making and move people to action. Our work promotes health and well-being, shapes resilient communities, and builds effective and accountable institutions. We are a certified B Corporation and a Top Workplace for 7 consecutive years.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

Fors Marsh is seeking an intelligent and motivated Researcher for a senior position with a background in quantitative social science or data science. This individual’s primary responsibility would be to support a portfolio of quantitative social science and data science research projects for our Personnel Health Research & Data Analysis (PHRDA) team. PHRDA bridges the gap between social science and data science, leveraging innovative analytics tools for research committed to improving the health, wellbeing, and quality of life for Service members and DoW personnel. We routinely synthesize diverse sources of information, including administrative, survey, and text data and distill complex information for policymakers. We also support a wide variety of data science and operational tasks that enable our clients to successfully and efficiently collect, integrate, manage, and maintain a variety of administrative and survey data sources.

This individual’s primary responsibility would include providing subject matter expertise and methodological expertise in areas such as machine learning, data wrangling, data management, advanced quantitative analysis, text analysis, automation, and artificial intelligence. This role will also involve overseeing a large project of foundational data science capabilities and will include leading a team of researchers, analysts, and data scientists as well as frequent engagement with clients. This individual should be equal parts social scientist, data scientist, and project manager. This job is best for someone who enjoys solving challenging problems with a large methodological toolkit, a high degree of intellectual curiosity, and thrives in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities include:

Analytical and Technical SkillsApply sophisticated principles in the fields of data science, quantitative social science, and/or programming to social science research projects and data science operational projects Serve as the technical lead on research projects with a data science focus Designing analytic solutions to ambiguous research questions and goals that may include techniques such as multi-level modeling (e.g., cross-classified random effects, linear mixed effects), data reduction (e.g., PCA, factor analysis, clustering), predictive model selection (e.g., LASSO, Ridge), natural language processing, and/or machine learning techniques Interpret results from data analyses to identify patterns, solutions, and recommendations; distill complex analyses and associated results for technical and non-technical audiences Communicate trade-offs associated with analytic approaches to technical and non-technical audiences Oversee survey workflows focused on population specification and sample frame development, including identifying relevant data sources, cleaning, deduplication, and frame quality checksLeverage AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, and reporting; lead the development internal prototypes and proofs of concept; enhance client offerings and expand AI capabilities; train other team members to build further AI proficiency Oversee work in R, Python, and Databricks to execute automation tasks, R package creation, data wrangling, exploratory data analysis, and executing advanced analyses Project ManagementOversee large, complex project to include developing task plans and timelines, implementing scope and financial controls, aligning staffing resources to project technical requirements, and ensure rigorous and timely delivery of all deliverables Lead a matrixed team of data scientists, researchers, and analysts to include delegating tasks and overseeing task and project completion, providing support, guidance, and mentorship to junior team membersCollaborate with other project leaders and supervisors across the organization to accomplish project resourcing needs Client and Stakeholder Interaction and CommunicationDevelop a deep understanding of client mission and objectives; directly interface with client teams and build strong, trusting relationships with clients to collaboratively accomplish project goals Ensure client satisfaction with all project deliverables Lead the development of client briefings and reports and mentor team members to deliver high-impact briefings to clients Oversee the preparation of reports for technical and non-technical audiences Respond to client requests for information and proposals and ad hoc requests Supervisory Responsibilities and Team OrientationOversee a small team of data scientists and analysts Work collaboratively with a mixed team of data and social scientists, cultivate a productive, growth-oriented work environment, propel team development

Master’s degree required; PhD preferred in a heavily quantitative social science (e.g., sociology, political science, psychology), data science, or related field A minimum of four years of post-graduate applied research experience leading applied research projects Experience managing multiple concurrent work streams, delegating and overseeing tasks, and supervisory experience Experience interfacing directly with clients, overseeing high-quality deliverable creation, and ensuring projects align with client expectations and quality standardsProficiency with AI-enabled toolsDemonstrated experience working with diverse data sources, including survey, personnel, administrative, and text dataWorking knowledge of survey workflows supporting population definition, sample frame construction, and feature table creation to assist in survey package and tool development (R and Python) Willingness and ability to learn new analytic approaches, methods, and research topic areas Strong verbal and written communications skills, including the ability to describe technical concepts and results to both technical and non-technical audiencesStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot barriers as they arise Experience working in R/R Studio requiredExperience with Databricks requiredExperience with Python requiredExperience with SQL preferred Experience with Gitlab preferredApplicants will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility criteria for access to sensitive information.Ability to work on-site in the Washington D.C. area 2-3 days a week.Must be a U.S. Citizen and consent to a full background check due to our federal contract requirements.

rows.title: Data Annotator
rows.descriptionText:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

About This Role

Produce high-fidelity annotations on imagery and video used to train and evaluate machine learning models. Annotators work to a defined ontology and labeling specification, meet project quality and throughput targets, and operate inside the designated annotation environment for each program. Assignments rotate across projects, modalities, and customers as program needs change.

Key Responsibilities

Label static imagery and video across a range of sensor types, image qualities, and scene conditions, including both real-world and synthetic data.Produce 2D bounding boxes, instance and semantic segmentation masks, and keypoint annotations to project specification.Produce oriented and rotated bounding boxes where scene geometry requires them.Produce 3D and 6 degrees-of-freedom pose, orientation, and scale annotations on projects that require them.Produce multi-object tracking annotations, maintaining consistent object identity across full sequences — through occlusion, frame exit and re-entry, scale change, and camera or platform motion.Review, correct, and accept or reject model-assisted and pre-labeled output; report systematic pre-label failure modes rather than silently correcting the same error frame by frame.Work strictly to the project ontology and guidelines; escalate ambiguous or out-of-ontology objects rather than guessing.Meet assigned accuracy and throughput targets, and hold that standard consistently across large batches.Complete rework promptly from QA feedback, applying the correction to comparable cases in the same batch.Log edge cases and recurring ambiguities so they can be adjudicated and folded into the guidelines.Follow all customer data-handling, confidentiality, and information security requirements for the assigned project, and keep required training current.

Must-Have Qualifications

1+ years of image or video annotation experience, or equivalent precision work in a quality-managed production environment.Working familiarity with at least one professional annotation platform (for example CVAT, V7 Darwin, Labelbox, Scale, or comparable).Practical understanding of bounding boxes, segmentation masks, keypoints, and object tracking — and of what makes each one correct rather than merely present.Strong visual attention to detail and the discipline to hold a standard across tens of thousands of frames.Ability to follow written labeling guidelines exactly, and to ask precise questions when they are silent on a case.Comfortable working in remote-desktop or browser-based environments.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience across multiple annotation modalities rather than a single task type.Experience with aerial, overhead, satellite, or thermal/IR imagery.Experience with long-form video and tracking work.Experience reviewing model-assisted pre-labels in a human-in-the-loop pipeline.Prior work on government or regulated-industry programs.

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $42,000 to $62.500 annually, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Program eligibility: Some programs require eligibility for a government background investigation or credentialing. Assignment to those programs is contingent on meeting those requirements.

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at verifyjoboffer@innodata.com and consider reporting it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

rows.title: Climate Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
POSITION TITLE: Climate Analyst

DEPARTMENT/PROGRAM: Conservation

REPORTS TO: Vice President, Climate

STATUS:  Regular, Full-Time, Exempt

LOCATION: Washington, DC preferred (hybrid); other states considered: AK, CA, FL, MD, OR, TX, WA, WV or VA

About Ocean Conservancy

For more than 50 years, Ocean Conservancy (OC) has delivered effective, evidence-based solutions for the ocean and all who depend on it. Today, we continue to unite science, people and policy to protect our ocean from the greatest challenges it faces: climate change, plastic pollution and biodiversity loss. We are a 501(C)3 headquartered in Washington, D.C. that inspires a worldwide network of partners, advocates and supporters through our comprehensive and clear-eyed approach to ocean conservation. Together, we are securing a healthy ocean and a thriving planet, forever and for everyone.

Position Summary

The Climate Analyst serves as a key member of Ocean Conservancy’s Climate Team, providing analytical, research, and strategic support to advance the organization's climate priorities. Reporting to the Vice President of Climate, this position works across programs to develop data-driven climate and economic analyses, evaluate domestic and international climate policy and finance opportunities, and produce high-quality written products that inform organizational strategy and external engagement.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional quantitative and analytical expertise with a solid understanding of climate science, climate finance, and policy. They are an outstanding writer who can translate complex technical information into compelling products for diverse audiences, including senior leadership, partners, community and private sector stakeholders, policymakers, and funders.

Primary Responsibilities

Climate Analytics and Strategic Research

Conduct and help oversee production of quantitative and qualitative analyses on climate-related issues, including greenhouse gas emissions, decarbonization pathways, and mitigation opportunities.Analyze climate data, economic models, financial mechanisms, and policy developments to support organizational priorities, including monitoring and synthesize developments in international, federal, state, and private-sector climate policy and finance.Evaluate greenhouse gas emissions, investment, and climate finance trends, investment opportunities, and emerging funding mechanisms relevant to ocean and climate solutions.Develop dashboards, briefing materials, and analytical tools that support strategic decision-making across the Climate Team and organization.

Cross-Functional Program Support

Serve as an analytical resource across Ocean Conservancy’s climate portfolio, collaborating with science, policy, conservation, communications, development, and government affairs teams.Support the Vice President for Climate and climate team members in drafting strategy documents and tracking implementation, including for fundraising.Support climate team members on implementation including programmatic work on offshore wind, clean shipping, mCDR, and offshore oil and gas.Coordinate cross-program projects requiring technical analysis and strategic input on organizational documents.Assist with preparation of presentations, executive briefings, and materials for Board meetings and external engagements.

Writing and Communications

Produce high-quality reports, policy briefs, white papers, grant materials, and technical summaries.Translate complex scientific and financial information into clear, accessible communications for varied audiences.Produce and contribute content for publications, presentations, thought leadership, and external communications.Ensure analytical rigor and consistency across climate-related organizational products.

Partnership and External Engagement

Support relationships with external experts, academic institutions, NGOs, philanthropic organizations, and private-sector partners.Support the Climate Team in developing and executing convenings and events in the United States and internationally.Represent the organization in meetings, conferences, and collaborative initiatives as appropriate.Assist with preparation of materials supporting coalition engagement and strategic partnerships.

Required Skills/Qualifications/Experience

Minimum of 2–3 years of relevant professional experience in climate, sustainability, environmental policy, climate finance, or related analytical work.Demonstrated expertise in interpreting and utilizing climate analytics to inform evidence-based decisions, including emissions accounting, climate modeling, scenario analysis, or quantitative policy analysis.Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.Outstanding written communication skills, with experience producing reports, policy analyses, and executive-level briefing materials.Experience synthesizing complex technical information into concise, actionable recommendations.Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.Occasional domestic and international travel may be required,

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in nonprofit organizations, consulting, philanthropy, government, or international organizations.Strong understanding of climate finance, sustainable finance, carbon markets, ESG frameworks, or related financial mechanisms.Experience supporting organizational strategy development or executive leadership in late-breaking requests.Passion for ocean conservation and the intersection of climate and marine ecosystems.

EDUCATION/TRAINING

Bachelor's degree in environmental science, economics, public policy, finance, engineering, data science, or a related field required.

Graduate degree in climate science, environmental economics, public policy, business, finance, or a related discipline preferred.

Compensation

Ocean Conservancy is committed to fair pay practices and posts expected salary ranges for each of its positions. Compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s specialty skills, years of experience, location, and unique background. The expected starting salary range for this role is $70,000 - $80,000 annually. We would welcome the opportunity to connect with potential candidates whose salary requirements may be outside of the expected range.

TO APPLY

If you think you’d be a great fit for the job and are interested in joining Ocean Conservancy’s team, please apply here. Please include a resume and cover letter in one file on your application.

HYBRID WORK ENVIRONMENT

Ocean Conservancy embraces a hybrid work environment, which allows our staff the flexibility to work virtually and in-person while building strong connections across the institution.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Ocean Conservancy provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

We encourage applicants who have a diverse level and range of relevant skills and experiences to apply. A 100% match is not required. We want to support employees’ career growth and in return, our employees help Ocean Conservancy grow into a stronger, more inclusive institution.

Brief Description

As a Data Analyst, your focus will be on collecting, analyzing, and interpreting marketing data to inform strategies and decisions for nonprofit clients across diverse channels. This role will give you the insights you need to develop your expertise in omnichannel marketing, nonprofit fundraising, and analytic toolsets.

Moore is a data-driven constituent experience management (CXM) company achieving accelerated growth for clients through integrated supporter experiences across all platforms, channels, and devices. We are an innovation-led company that is the largest marketing, data, and fundraising company in North America, serving the purpose-driven industry with clients across education, association, political, and commercial sectors.

Check out www.WeAreMoore.com for more information.

Your Impact:

Design and maintain comprehensive reports, dashboards, Key Performance Indicators, and other business tools to inform client strategy. Leverage your coding skills to transform data into useable information that can be presented in Power BI, Excel, and/or other reporting tools. Apply technical skills to deploy automated procedures that drive efficient data ingestion and transformation. Identify trends, patterns, and outliers in complex data sets to drive decisions. Work with internal team members to develop deep knowledge of our clients’ programs to produce more relevant analysis and deepen your analytic abilities. Collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy. Identify errors in data files or reports and take measures to resolve them. Perform other duties as required. 


Your Profile: 

Bachelor’s degree 1-3 years’ experience in an analytical role Experience in direct marketing preferred Excellent analytical skills. Effective communication skills. Ability to present findings clearly and concisely. Familiarity with fundraising metrics, file segmentation techniques, and direct marketing strategy. Demonstrated, hands-on experience with SQL and Python; a Snowflake environment a plus. Fundamental understanding of relational database design and reporting systems. Intermediate to advanced users of Excel with strong ability in formulas, functions, and pivot tables. Experience with statistical analysis methods and concepts like randomized controlled trials, hypothesis testing, summary statistics, regression, and other explanatory and predictive modeling frameworks. Experience with direct marketing and attribution across multiple channels, including but not limited to direct mail, website, digital advertising, email, and direct response TV. Attention to detail with the intrinsic ability to identify anomalies, discover the root cause, and correct underlying issues
