parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

As part of the Product Management team, this role partners with Design, Merchandising, Technical Design, Sourcing Offices, Factories, and Mills to help ensure the integrity of product from sample through bulk production. This individual works closely with cross-functional partners to support seasonal priorities, resolve product issues, and maintain alignment across key milestones and deliverables.

,

Create and maintain Air table seasonal base throughout product lifecycle – work closely with Design and Fabric teams to receive updates and communicate to cross functional teams in timely manner Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor progress against product and seasonal objectives Support the management of lead times and key activities from development through store delivery Partner with Product Testing team to ensure design execution meets Product Standards/RL requirements Work closely with team to maintain development and production costing for products, ensure all costs are updated, accurate and communicated properly to cross functional teams Partner with Merchandising and supply chain teams to track production status, shipments schedules and delivery milestones Identify and escalate risks related to delays, cost fluctuations, or material availability while supporting solutions that uphold brand standards and operational excellence 

Salary range: $65,000 - $129,225 annually,

 Bachelor’s degree preferred Knowledge of garment manufacturing process and product development Proven ability to quickly pivot and problem solve utilizing innovative solutions Actively displays curiosity, a desire to learn and grow, and an innovative mind-set Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn insights into practical actions Strong organizational skills and attention to detail Embodies the Cultural Focus Areas of the RL Brand

rows.descriptionText:
Relocation Assistance Offered Within Country

Job Number #175780 - Hodges, South Carolina, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Human Resources professionals are consistently drawn to Colgate-Palmolive by the exceptional opportunities for career advancement and a strong alignment with our globally recognized, purpose-driven brand and company Values: We are Caring, We are Inclusive, We are Courageous. At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

What to Expect:

Are you a driven and ambitious professional eager to make a lasting impact in Human Resources? Nestlé invites you to embark on an exciting journey through our esteemed HR Development Program (HRDP). Our goal is to cultivate a talented pool of exceptional HR Business Partners, poised to become future leaders in our factory and distribution center locations.

Over 24 months, you will gain invaluable exposure working in diverse manufacturing and distribution facilities across multiple U.S. cities. You will receive in-depth learning experiences led by our top HR Specialist groups, including People Analytics, Labor & Employee Relations, Total Rewards, Employment Law, and our various Talent specialists. These learnings will be put into practice immediately during your time in the program.

At Nestlé, our HRDPs serve as strategic partners, leveraging their HR expertise to tackle real-world business challenges and contribute significantly to the success of our iconic product lines. You will play a key role in driving employee development, managing employee and labor relations, interpreting policies and contracts, overseeing compensation administration, staffing, and ensuring legal compliance.

What sets our program apart is the responsibility entrusted to our trainees, coupled with extensive support. You will benefit from the guidance of dedicated direct report managers, a seasoned HR Leadership mentor, and a peer ambassador. This comprehensive network will empower you to excel, facilitating your growth into a well-rounded HR professional.

Our program offers a blend of structured learning experiences and hands-on opportunities, equipping you with a diverse skillset upon completion. Join us on this dynamic journey that will shape your future as an HR leader. Apply to Nestlé's HR Development Program today and make your mark in the world of HR.

Program Breakdown: 

Dive into cutting-edge strategic immersion experiences across multiple vital HR areas, such as recruitment, compensation, talent management, people analytics, organizational development, and employee benefits. Immerse yourself in the world of HR as you learn and apply essential HR Business Partner activities, gaining a solid foundation in the daily responsibilities of an HR Generalist in a factory or distribution center setting. This is your chance to make a real impact and shape the culture with our associates and leaders. Take charge of exciting HR projects from various specialist groups, showcasing your skills and expertise. This includes delivering a quarterly presentation to the esteemed HR Leadership Team, where you'll present your findings and recommendations. Foster open and effective communication with employees, serving as a trusted advisor and liaison between associates and management. Provide guidance on policies and procedures to maintain a productive and positive work environment. Drive the development and implementation of people processes that attract, train, and retain top talent, aligning with the organization's short and long-term business goals. Offer mentorship and support to supervisors in navigating people management and development challenges. Build strong and collaborative relationships with business partners, employee client groups, and, where applicable, union management. Foster an inclusive and diverse work environment that values teamwork and collaboration. Demonstrate skills in performance management, employee communications, employee relations processes, and local HR initiatives and priorities. Ensure flawless execution of these critical HR functions, contributing to the overall success of the site and organization. 

Graduation Placement Assignment (Program Completion)

Upon completing your 24 month program, you'll graduate from our dynamic HR Development Program and step into a full-time HR Generalist role where you’ll continue building your career in factory HR. These positions offer a comprehensive and immersive experience, tailored to the needs of ambitious professionals like you. Harness your diverse experiences and insights to excel in driving HR success and shaping the future of HR at Nestlé.

Qualifications: 

Bachelor’s degree completed and available to start the program by June 2027 Preferred majors include but are not limited to: Business Administration, Human Resources, Labor and Employment Relations, or related fields. Minimum GPA of 3.0 preferred Previous experience in a customer-facing environment and/or HR internship preferred Willingness to relocate throughout program and career Willingness to support off shift coverage and work extended hours as needed Sponsorship for work visas are not available for this program 

Knowledge & Skills: 

Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills; ability to analyze data and make data driven decisions Ability and eagerness to navigate ambiguous situations as well as exhibits professional maturity Excellent communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills Ability to prioritize workload and self-manage projects, handle multiple tasks, and meet strict deadlines Strong problem solving and decision-making skills Ability to work with all levels of employees and management within the organization Previous experience working in a manufacturing environment preferred, but not required Must possess strong presentation and training skills Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Access). Preferred experience with an HRIS system (such as SAP, SuccessFactors) 

Program Benefits:

Exposure to senior leadership through project presentation. Collection of support resources included: Direct Report Manager, Senior HR Mentor, and Peer Ambassador Opportunity to network with various divisions and employees across the company. Total Rewards Package including base salary, supplemented corporate housing for first rotation (if applicable), comprehensive benefits, 401k with employer matching, relocation assistance, and more Volunteer in a community service opportunity with one of Nestlé’s Share Valued Organizations (e.g. Boys & Girls Club of America & Nestlé Adopt-A-School Program) 

The approximate pay for this position is $70,000 annually. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skill and abilities as well as geographic location. Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which inculdes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or beneift packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at Nestle in the US Benefits | Nestlé Careers.

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. Contact us at accommodations@nestle.com or please dial 711 and provide this number to the operator: 1-800-321-6467.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Review our applicant privacy notice before applying at https://www.nestlejobs.com/privacy.

Job Number #175529 - New York, New York, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Job Summary:

In this absolutely critical role, you will lead key meetings and workshops with multidisciplinary regional teams to communicate the Professional Strategy and provide guidance to ensure it is flawlessly executed. You will provide guidance to the Marketing teams on how to adjust and implement the strategies at a local level, lead global scope projects leveraging the 4CP framework, and actively participate in global multifunctional meetings to provide the essential Marketing perspective and drive impactful decisions that shape our future.

Main Responsibilities:

Development and Leadership of a Global Professional Products Grid, working in close synergy with the H2/3 innovation teams. Lead Professional content development, collaborating with Scientific Affairs, R&D, Agency, and key Division partners. Develop the professional content principles, ensuring global adherence and seamless accessibility/diffusion. Provide transformative strategic guidance to the operating Divisions. Partner with the Global Finance, Insights and Analytics functions to build existing and identify new business opportunities. Set objectives for the R&D function for new technology development and align with the global supply chain on critical capital expenditures, strategic sourcing decisions, and cost optimization opportunities. Elevate growth engines to Senior Management, proactively identifying regional initiatives that demand to scale up. Provide Senior Management with visibility on the strategy and main projects that can be scaled up. Identify key business challenges with global impact and boldly recommend a decisive course of action. Create new Professional tools for Divisions. Consolidate and update Innovation Grids across all markets to keep communication and best practices flowing throughout the organization. Provide a compelling global vision and strategically help prioritize initiatives that will deliver the biggest impact on the business and optimize resources 

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree12+ years of working experience with marketing roles, management or entrepreneurship, or adjacent experiences with a public, major multinational companyExperience with innovation around regulated/drug productsNew product innovation and business model developmentStrong business acumenExperience in managing within a global, matrix organizationBusiness partnership experience working with senior business leaders to influence strategy and business decision makingCreative thinking, problem solving skills, and a never-ending desire for learningExperience leveraging AI models 

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's DegreeExcellent communication, presentation, and collaboration skills with both business and technical professionals Digital health and pharma experienceConsumer Goods industry experience

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $220,000.00 - $244,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

rows.title: Principal Consumer Technical Insights Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Principal Consumer Technical Insights Scientist 

Join our team as a Principal Consumer Technical Insights Scientist at Mars Snacking! We are looking for a sensory and consumer scientist with strong analytical statistical and sensory/consumer research skills. This position will lead complex projects and apply advanced research methodologies to a variety of objectives. This position is based out of Chicago. Estimated travel is 10-20%.

 

Use your deep sensory consumer science and statistical/ technical skills to distill complex problems and drive new product development, product quality, productivity, and cost-effectiveness projects. As a highly experienced technical resource to various functions, you will influence strategy with rich data insights and sensory/consumer research leadership o cross-functional project teams. Together we will build a stronger future for our company and your career.

What are we looking for?

Master’s/PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Consumer Science, Psychology, Statistics, or related disciplineMinimum 12 years' experience with deep technical roles and recognized subject-matter expertise and complex project leadership. Experience as a statistical subject matter expert for sensory and consumer research, advising teams on sample size determination and analytical approaches.Demonstrated success developing predictive models linking sensory attributes to consumer acceptance, product quality and business outcomes. 

What will your key responsibilities be?

Cross-Functional Team Collaboration – Serve as a recognized technical expert on cross functional product development teams to influence strategy using advanced sensory, consumer and data analysis tools. This position works closely with product development, marketing, marketing research, quality assurance, manufacturing and other Consumer Technical Insights (CTI) scientists. Mentor CTI scientists and R&D across technical expertise areas to build the overall organizational capabilities. Test Execution and Methodology – Independently lead, design and conduct complex research studies that result in actionable outcomes. You will use risk-based assessments to design learning plans that include a variety of analytical sensory and and consumer techniques build on advanced data analytics/tools. Shape the future of CTI research through experimentation with new methods and data modeling/analysis applications. Drive standardization of best practices.Technical Recommendations - Provide technical recommendations based on your knowledge of statistics, data science, consumer psychology and behavioral science, food chemistry, packaging, and product development as it applies to sensory and consumer research. Industry Knowledge – As a Principal CTI scientist, you will be scanning the horizon for cutting edge sensory science/analysis methods through meetings and conferences. You will network with suppliers and experts in the field to vet and implement new methods. 

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is between the range listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will include variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an applicant receives an offer of employment.

The pay range shown is applicable to all US locations listed within the job posting:USD 134,400.00 - USD 184,800.00

rows.descriptionText:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

The Brand Merchandising Lead for Sportswear, Footwear & Accessories will be directly responsible for driving Brand Merchandising Strategy and execution for Men’s Purple Label in partnership with design, product development, marketing and regional buying partners, and influence set strategies with other cross functional partners.

,

Lead brand and product strategy – from concept phase with design through execution at store level, including long range strategy setting, seasonal strategy, and line-planning.Support DTC Assortment process and Wholesale go-to-Market activity.Drive to Long Range Plan Targets- global sales growth across the following categories: Outerwear, Sweaters, Shirts, Bottoms, Denim, Footwear, Luggage, Belts, Small Leather Goods, Hats.Responsible for strategic and line-plan coordination with Men’s Purple Label to create comprehensive approach to growing Men’s Sportswear, Footwear & Accessories.Responsible for supporting MTO business for Purple Label Sportswear, Footwear & Accessories, working closely with Design, PMT and Regional Buying and Retail teams.Drive the implementation of new MTO digital platform in partnership with Innovation and Production teams.Partner with Senior Brand Creative Director & Design team to ensure design vision is captured while meeting and exceeding revenue and profit goals Understand the target customer archetypes, informed by a deep knowledge of the consumer and competitive landscape and in support of the brand priorities. Identify growth opportunities in product offer; validated by analytics, commercial hindsight learnings and global market research. Accountable for financial performance by monitoring sales, identifying losses, competitive analysis regarding pricing, profit, marketing, etc. In partnership with product management team, monitor divisional adherence to deadlines to ensure timely deliveries. Oversee seasonal brand merchandising strategies and assortment presentations to commercial and cross functional partners. Create clear product briefs for all new developments; clearly articulating target customer, competitive benchmarks and product attributes including target price and AUC. Partner with regional buying teams to ensure vision and message of the concept is reflected at the retail level. In conjunction with regional buying & retail teams, provide framework & implementation of product training Maintain knowledge of industry/market trends through business, competitive analysis and a synthesis of commercial feedback and input. Strengthen the talent of the company by leading peers, promoting successful partnerships, and managing effective and diverse teams.

Salary range: $85,000 - $161,444 annually,

Proven expertise and experience with men’s luxury at comparable brands with a focus in sportswear categories

 Superior product savvy and commercial acumen - in equal parts Ability to quickly identify market value drivers; prioritize and act on opportunities to position the business for growth. Successful track record of consistently delivering profitable growth. A career demonstrating solid leadership skills and cross-functional influencing skills; a proven ability to develop and implement new strategies in competitive business situations. Ability to successfully motivate, negotiate and influence effectively across departments & divisions strong understanding of the product life cycle & business calendars. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. High emotional intelligence and relationship building skills. Highly collaborative with cross functional partners – design, product development, regional buying, marketing etc Exceptional people management and leadership skills. Comprehensive understanding of Retail Math - business terminology, key retail metrics and calculations Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Word/PowerPoint.

The Planogram Specialist partners with Category Leadership Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to influence, build, validate, and execute merchandising solutions that support category growth. The role also contributes to assortment and layout thinking by applying shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights to strengthen shelf construct recommendations, planogram testing, heat mapping, and best-practice deployment.

Responsibilities

Planogram Development & Execution

 Builds multiple versions of planograms based on pre-established assortment, clustering nuances, fixture variations, merchandising guidelines, and retailer-specific requirements, while simultaneously developing customer-specific Gold Standard POG recommendations that optimize product flow, brand blocking, adjacencies, capacity, and execution feasibility to drive immediate merchandising objectives and support long-term category growth, shopper navigation, and strategic retailer goals. Reviews, validates, and revises planograms for adherence to retailer strategy, merchandising standards, fixture /labor realities, and execution readiness. Manages relay execution for assigned categories, including workload forecasting, project coordination, deadlines, and issue resolution required for successful implementation. Provides planogram support for display merchandising where applicable, including virtual store environments, 3D product builds, video tours, promotional concepts, and customer-facing visual assets that communicate the merchandising story.

Assortment, Layout & Shelf Strategy Support

 Supports assortment and layout strategy development by translating shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights into informed shelf recommendations. Contributes to planogram testing, heat mapping, clustering evaluations, fixture alternatives, and shelf construct analysis to improve category and brand outcomes. Provides analytical support for innovation, renovation, and new item/segment display considerations as needed.

Reporting, Analytics & Decision Support

 Conducts ad hoc analytics to answer business questions from Customer Merchants, Category Advisors, Category Leadership Managers, and non-advising teams. Supports business reviews and insights development using available resources such as JDA/Blue Yonder, retailer data, and internal reporting. Measures effectiveness of planogram, assortment, and shelving actions by connecting execution outputs to performance indicators where available.

Tools, Data & Capability Enablement

 Helps develop and improve the planogram toolbox, including standardized tables, templates, reporting views, process documents, and shared knowledge resources. Identifies opportunities to test, validate, and scale tools or automation that improve planogram development, reporting, and execution efficiency. Supports onboarding, training content, and best-practice sharing for analysts, field category teams, and partners using planogram or space planning tools. Maintains strong relationship with Acosta, Shopper MX, and key internal stakeholders to optimize merchandising tools, data integrity, digital assets, and operational processes, driving efficiencies, improving execution quality, and identifying scalable, cost-effective solutions that advance category management capabilities and customer outcomes.

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

 Acts as an efficient collaborator by sharing reporting, best practices, learnings, and reusable tools across divisions and customer teams. Brings forward-thinking recommendations through proposals, planogram testing insights, heat mapping, and scalable process improvements that support total Nestlé growth. Builds trusted relationships with Category Leadership, Space Planning Management, field sales, and cross-functional partners to improve quality, speed, and alignment.

Requirements

Education & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2+ years of experience in Sales, Analytics, Space Management, Category Management, or a related manufacturer/retailer role; CPG and/or food industry experience a plus, with demonstrated ability to influence merchandising recommendations through buyer-facing storytelling, cross-functional partnership, and category strategy application.

Technical & Analytical Skills

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel; advanced analytical aptitude and ability to develop business and category knowledge, including the expertise to simplify complex data into clear visuals, shelf stories, and executive-ready recommendations. Experience with Blue Yonder/JDA Space Management preferred; ability to use SQL, Python, or similar tools to improve data extraction, analysis, or planogram workflows a plus. Ability to use retailer, marketplace, shopper, category, and performance data to address business questions and improve merchandising recommendations.

Core Capabilities

 Strong project management, prioritization, and change-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently and in a team environment. Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into clear recommendations. Demonstrated initiative, tenacity, curiosity, and problem-solving; willingness to challenge current ways of working and help build future-state capabilities. Position Summary

The Specialist, Category Management & Shelf Strategy supports the development and execution of customer-centric category growth strategies for Nutrition while leading planogram development, shelf optimization, reporting, and execution support. This role combines category analytics, shopper and retailer insights, assortment and layout strategy, and space planning expertise to create actionable recommendations that improve product visibility, shopper experience, and category performance. Working closely with Category Managers, Category Leadership Managers, Sales, Space Planning, and cross-functional partners, this role translates data and insights into compelling category stories, scalable tools, and effective shelf solutions that can be executed with speed, quality, and consistency across customers and divisions.

Key Responsibilities

Category Strategy & Analytics

Support Category Managers and Category Leadership Managers in developing customer-specific category growth strategies, business reviews, and customer-facing recommendations. Analyze syndicated, customer, shopper, retailer, marketplace, and internal performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, whitespace, and growth drivers. Develop category stories and recommendations related to assortment, pricing, promotion, merchandising, innovation, renovation, new item support, and display considerations. Conduct performance analyses, including pre- and post-evaluation of category initiatives, merchandising programs, planogram actions, assortment changes, and shelving recommendations. Translate analysis into clear, actionable insights and visual storytelling for internal planning, customer meetings, and business decision support. 

Planogram Development, Validation & Execution 

Build, maintain, validate, revise, and execute multiple versions of planograms based on assortment, clustering alternatives, fixture variations, merchandising guidelines, retailer requirements, and customer objectives. Review planograms for adherence to retailer strategy, merchandising standards, fixture realities, execution readiness, and quality requirements. Provide support for display merchandising, modular events, shelf layouts, product placement, and retail partner implementation where applicable. 

Assortment, Layout & Shelf Strategy 

Support assortment and layout strategy development by applying shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights to strengthen shelf recommendations. Contribute to planogram testing, heat mapping, clustering evaluations, fixture alternative assessments, and shelf construct analysis to improve category and brand outcomes. Analyze shelf performance and recommend space allocation improvements that maximize category growth, product visibility, and shopper experience. Monitor and measure shelf strategy effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 

Tools, Data & Capability Enablement 

Use planogram, space management, category, and reporting tools to improve accuracy, efficiency, and consistency in planogram development and maintenance. Help develop and improve the planogram toolbox, including standardized tables, templates, reporting views, process documents, and shared knowledge resources. Identify opportunities to test, validate, and scale tools or automation that improve planogram development, reporting, analytics, and execution workflows. 

Collaboration & Thought Leadership 

Partner with Category Management, Category Leadership, Sales, Space Planning, Customer Teams, Field Sales, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure recommendations translate into executable shelf solutions. Share reporting, best practices, learnings, and reusable tools across divisions and customer teams to improve quality, speed, and alignment. Bring forward-thinking recommendations through proposals, planogram testing insights, heat mapping, scalable process improvements, and new ways of working that support total Nestlé growth. Build trusted relationships with internal and external partners while demonstrating curiosity, initiative, tenacity, and a continuous-improvement mindset. 

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Consumer Insights, Retail Management, Space Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience considered. 2+ years of experience in Sales, Category Management, Shopper Insights, Analytics, Space Management, or a related manufacturer/retailer role; CPG and/or food industry experience preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint; ability to synthesize data and translate analytics into business recommendations, execution plans, and customer-facing stories. Experience with Blue Yonder/JDA Space Management or similar planogram/space planning tools preferred. Ability to use retailer, marketplace, shopper, category, and performance data sources such as Circana, NielsenIQ, Numerator, retailer data, and internal reporting to address business questions and improve merchandising recommendations. Experience using SQL, Python, automation, or similar tools to improve data extraction, analysis, reporting, or planogram workflows is a plus. 

Core Capabilities

Strong analytical, storytelling, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations. Strong project management, prioritization, and change-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently and in a team environment. Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, problem-solving, and willingness to challenge current ways of working while helping build future-state capabilities. Ability to collaborate across Category Leadership, Field Sales, Space Planning, customer teams, and cross-functional partners while sharing knowledge and best practices. 

Travel 

Approximately 15–20% travel may be required for national meetings, local customer meetings, store visits, and other business needs.

rows.title: Senior Data Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will operate as a technical expert responsible for designing, building, and scaling enterprise-grade data engineering solutions across our cloud-native data platform on Azure and Databricks. This role requires deep technical knowledge, strong engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver high-impact solutions that support analytics, AI/ML, operational reporting, and streaming data solutions.

You will partner closely with Data Architects, Platform Admins, Cloud Engineers, Product Owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate strategy and architecture into production-grade high-quality solutions. You will lead complex technical work within your domain, mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and influence delivery across multiple products, platforms, and business capabilities.

General Responsibilities

Apply advanced technical knowledge to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, reusable engineering frameworks, and platform capabilities using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Spark, streaming and related cloud-native technologies. Lead engineering design and implementation for ingestion, transformation, and data product frameworks that support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data at enterprise scale. Implement automation for data ingestion, processing, validation, and monitoring to ensure reliability and observability. Drive implementation of future-state data architecture and cloud migration patterns, ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, maintainable, and aligned to enterprise modernization goals. Optimize data workflows for performance and cost, leveraging Delta Lake, partitioning, caching, and compute scaling strategies. Define data access controls and RBAC policies in collaboration with security and governance teams. Provide technical leadership within the team by mentoring engineers, reviewing solution designs, setting engineering standards, and promoting best practices for CI/CD, testing, automation, observability, and cloud-native delivery. Partner with AI/ML, analytics, and business teams to enable high-value real-time and batch data activation use cases that improve decision-making and business outcomes. Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security standards. 

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in data engineering, including experience delivering complex, enterprise-scale data solutions; Azure experience preferred. Advanced technical expertise in Cloud based data warehouses (Databricks Preferred), Spark, Delta Lake, Azure Services, data integration, data modeling, and performance optimization. Proven experience in building and optimizing large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and data lakehouse architectures. Solid understanding of data lakehouse modeling, data warehousing, and performance tuning. Experience with Customer 360 data products, identity resolution, customer profile enrichment, and activation use cases is highly desired. Experience designing and supporting streaming data solutions is highly desired, including Kafka or similar event streaming platforms. Martech exposure is preferred, including experience supporting marketing, personalization, campaign, loyalty, or customer engagement data use cases. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM templates) and DevOps tools (Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). Familiarity with RBAC, data security, and compliance frameworks. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical direction, clarify tradeoffs, and align engineering decisions across teams and stakeholders. Experience with Agile methodologies and working in cross-functional product teams. Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, manage technical ambiguity, and drive outcomes across a broad scope of products, platforms, and stakeholders. 

Additional Information

Benefits:

 Paid Holidays and Vacation   Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents Childcare tuition discounts No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs Fertility benefits Adoption assistance 401k matching contributions   15% off the purchase price of stock   Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

rows.title: Software Engineer II
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

A Software Engineer II is proficient with the most-often used features of the programming language, its core library, commonly used 3rd party libraries, and commonly used code management and build tooling.

Initially a Software Engineer II is expected to be able to develop a medium set of defined, inter-related modules, articulate why the code and application they are working on are designed the way they are, and be able to provide some instructive feedback to newer developers through code reviews and in-person Q&A. As they progress, they should be able to implement smaller subsystems independently, begin to design small portions of the systems, and begin to understand the design principles and practices that cut across all the applications.

The goals of a Software Engineer II are:

Develop an understanding of why some libraries, frameworks, and tooling are designed the way they are: what tradeoffs were made? why might the developer have done that? Through this work, develop an understanding of the practical use of design patterns. Begin to understand some of the externalities associated with running an application: performance, security, operations, monitoring, etc. Be able to troubleshoot application, infrastructure, and environment issues. 

Or, more succinctly, the Software Engineer II is gaining the ability to determine why things are done in a particular way and apply that knowledge to new situations.

General Responsibilities

Development - 90%

Produces estimates for their assigned tasks given well defined business requirementsProduces quality code that meets internal and industry standardsPromotes reusability within the application they are developingWrites performant code according to industry standards and project/organizational KPIsUnderstands business concepts in their area of focusWrites clear documentation to ensure code is understandable to provide wider focus and understanding into design decisionsProvides input into designs for assigned tasksTranslates designs into code for their assigned tasksUnderstands build/deployment processes and can support moving their code and any other changes (ex: database) through these phases. Creates build/deployment artifacts as neededSupports production systems through troubleshooting/triaging issues and providing on-call support where needed

Mentoring - 10%

Participates in PR reviews with others on their teamProvides feedback by answering questions from newer developers

Qualifications

Basic understanding of design methods/patterns such as DRY, SOLID, ReSTExcellent team player with good communication skills with both non-technical & technical co-workersHighly motivated and driven by a desire to solve difficult problems, and learn new technologyProficient in writing quality unit testsProficient with build and debug toolsExperience with profiling toolsExperience with continuous integration systems like Jenkins/GitHub and version control systems like GitExperience with development of internationalized software (multi-lingual, multi-currency, geographic, and locale awareness) Experience with agile practices and tools preferred (Jira or similar)Experience with database concepts (queries, data models)Understanding of development in a distributed system is preferredUnderstanding of basic networking concepts like http protocol and its usage is preferred

Native App Qualifications

5+ years overall development experience using an object oriented language Proficient in Kotlin and/or Swift Demonstrable proficency with XCode and/or Android Studio Demonstrable experience with Java and/or Objective-C. Demonstrable experience consuming Restful JSON web services Demonstrable experience with Agile development and unit testing. Demonstrable experience with push notifications, location services. Experience with various architecture patterns like MVC, MVVM, VIPER, or similar Experience with accessibility frameworks Experience with analytics frameworks such as Firebase, Adobe, or similar Experience builds tools like Gradle and Fastlane Knowledge of submitting and publishing applications through app store

Additional Information

Benefits:

 Paid Holidays and Vacation   Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents Childcare tuition discounts No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs Fertility benefits Adoption assistance 401k matching contributions   15% off the purchase price of stock   Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

rows.title: Manager, Client Sales & Insights
rows.descriptionText:
Client Sales and Insights - Manager, Mid-Market Food and Beverage (Beverage Client)

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

This is a unique opportunity to work with a leading beverage manufacturer and join a dynamic high-performing team to leverage data, analytics, and insights to inform growth strategy and address other critical business issues. We seek candidates with previous sales, market research, consumer packaged goods (CPG), retailer or marketing services experience, along with a keen interest in slicing and dicing data to reveal proactive actionable insights into consumers, shoppers, retailers, and in-market performance. Strong sales, analysis and communication skills are preferred. Attention to detail will be essential to success in this role.

Job Responsibilities

Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals. Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Insights, Product, and Analytics) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success. Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay current on trends in [retail, CPG, or general merchandise] to position Circana as a thought leader and trusted advisor. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. Ensure data accuracy and consistency through regular quality checks and scheduled updates of syndicated and custom tools and deliverablesContribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance workflows, tools, training, and overall client experience

Requirements 

Bachelor’s degree3+ years of progressive business experience with a strong understanding of manufacturer/retailer issues having worked in one or more of the environments below:Retailer (any channel)Consumer Packaged GoodsManufacturerExperience working with syndicated data, analytics, and category management. 2+ years of experience working with syndicated data, analytics, category management, or related CPG insights roles, including experience with POS, consumer panel or syndicated data sources. Sales experienceSuccessful storytelling that is proactive and concise in delivering results for both Circana and the client. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

As BBC News accelerates its growth on YouTube, you'll play a central role in defining how our journalism reaches and engages audiences on one of the world's most influential platforms. WHY JOIN THE TEAM

Join one of the fastest-growing and most ambitious areas of BBC News. Following the launch of the BBC's strategic partnership with YouTube, teams across the UK and around the world are redefining how trusted journalism reaches audiences on the platform. As an Assistant Editor, you'll help shape YouTube strategy, lead a talented team, develop new formats and work on some of the world's biggest stories. BBC News is on a mission to be the number one brand on social for news, and you will play a pivotal role in this work. This is a rare opportunity to combine editorial leadership, audience insight and innovation to help build the future of BBC News.

Lead and develop a small, high-performing team, creating an environment where people can do their best work and deliver real impact.Shape and deliver BBC News' YouTube strategy, using audience insight and platform expertise to drive growth and engagement.Work with journalists, creators and production teams across BBC News to identify opportunities and turn great journalism into successful YouTube content.Champion the value of YouTube across BBC News, helping colleagues maximise the reach and impact of their reporting on the platform.Oversee the development and delivery of platform-native formats that strengthen BBC News' relationship with existing and new audiences.Use performance data and audience insights to evaluate content, identify opportunities and inform editorial and creative decision-making.Foster innovation and experimentation, helping BBC News adapt to changing audience behaviours and platform trends.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer, Java
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  About The TeamThe Roku Enterprise Engineering team is at the forefront of building a robust, integrated, and scalable platform that powers critical business processes across the organization. As a cornerstone of Roku's corporate strategy, this team is instrumental in automating workflows across all Business Systems, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Operations, and Human Resources. By challenging traditional approaches to workflow automation, the team leverages cutting-edge Engineering practices and API-driven design to streamline internal processes, boost efficiency, and deliver innovative solutions.The team's expertise spans a wide range of technologies, including Java and Python-based MicroServices, AWS/GCP cloud backend systems, Big Data technologies like Hive and Spark, and modern Web applications. With a globally distributed presence across the US, India and Europe, the team thrives on collaboration, bringing together diverse perspectives to solve complex challenges. At the heart of their success is a shared commitment to technical excellence, creativity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative spirit that drives impactful results for Roku's business operations. About The RoleAs a senior technical lead, you consider yourself a platform services developer and developing innovative solutions using modern software frameworks and paradigms. You are self-driven and problem solver, with a strong background in building large-scale software platform and applications. You are execution focused and would develop a reputation for repeatedly delivering projects on-time. What you'll be doingDesign, develop and deploy scalable web applications and services, being part of everything from contributing to web technology and framework stack, to use case and data model designDrive architecture discussions, take ownership and responsibility over new projects, and deliver high quality software with tight timelinePartner with security and compliance teams to ensure the application meets compliance, security and audit requirementsParticipate in the continual improvement of engineering tools, cloud-based technologies/services, and processDefine and participate in Agile development process, including scoping, technical design, estimation effort, coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, maintenance and supportCollaborate with cross-function teams and demonstrate great communication skills We're excited if you have5+ years of experience in delivery multi-tier, highly scalable, distributed web applicationDeep understanding in software architecture, object-oriented design principles, and data structuresExtensive experience in developing microservices using Java, PythonGood experience in Test driven development and automating test cases using Java/ PythonExperience in SQL / NoSQL (Oracle, Cassandra) database designDemonstrated ability to be proactive, self-driven, and make practical trade-offs based on business needs, entrepreneurial spiritExcellent verbal and written communication skillsBS or MS degree in Computer Science or equivalentExperience in distributed computing frameworks like - Hive/Hadoop, Apache SparkExperience in developing Finance or HR related applicationsExperience with following cloud services: AWS Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, Elastic Cache, LambdaWorking experience with TerraformExperience in creating workflows for Apache Airflow  Our Hybrid Work ApproachRoku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy. BenefitsRoku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. The Roku CultureRoku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

rows.title: Senior Business Analyst, Content Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Business Analyst within the Content Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as an analytical leader and trusted thought partner for our senior Content leadership team, as well as the primary analytics conduit for European Content teams. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving the analytical frameworks and reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization.

Working in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, you'll transform multi-source data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive long-term strategy. Your deep expertise in the Content business — spanning audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media — will allow you to proactively anticipate leadership questions and surface insights before they're asked. As a content data SME, you'll help drive data quality standards within your domain while making insights readily accessible through efficient, scalable, self-service solutions.

About You

You are an analytical leader who balances technical expertise with deep business acumen, particularly within the world of content. You excel at working cross-functionally, translating complex business challenges into robust analytical frameworks and long-term solutions. You're naturally curious, with a talent for looking beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions driving our Content business forward.

You thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with strong judgment while continuously raising the bar on data processes and analytical best practices. Your communication skills are exceptional — you distill complex analyses into compelling, influential narratives for both technical and executive audiences. You build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders that position your insights to meaningfully influence business strategy and decision-making across the organization.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will...

 Proactively identify complex or ambiguous business problems and serve as a thought partner to senior Content leadership — anticipating questions, designing long-term analytics solutions, and developing analyses and visualizations that address emerging business needs before they're raised Design and own end-to-end reporting processes that track KPIs, support business reviews, and enable self-serve data access — ensuring speed, reliability, and scalability; break down high-level metrics into constituent components and leading indicators that generate actionable insights and recommendations for MBR/QBR/HBR cycles Develop concise, impactful narratives and visualizations — including MBR/QBR documents and 6-pagers — that communicate complex trends, root cause analyses, and strategic recommendations to executive audiences; automate the identification of key dimensions driving metric variance to enable faster, more consistent analysis Apply deep content domain expertise — spanning production, distribution, and audience engagement — alongside awareness of micro and macro industry trends in books and digital media, to ensure analytics solutions are grounded in real business context Serve as the analytics conduit for European Content teams, facilitating analyses and surfacing insights that connect regional performance to Global team strategy Partner cross-functionally with data scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, product managers, and business leaders to align analytical solutions with strategic objectives; own the effective communication of metrics and analyses across your organization, and identify when to bring in technical partners to unlock new insights Drive operational excellence and data governance by improving, streamlining, and/or eliminating excess processes; work with data owners to onboard new sources, guarantee data fidelity, and ensure consistency in metric definitions, documentation standards, and data quality Mentor and develop peers within your organization, modeling analytical best practices in design, delivery, and long-term scalability; develop clear documentation that enables both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand and replicate reporting methodologies

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

 Knowledge of advanced skills in Excel as well as any data visualization tools like Tableau or similar BI tools (familiarity with Tableau preferred) Experience in a data driven/analytical role Experience delivering complex, end-to-end analytics solutions independently in ambiguous spaces, with track record of generating recommendations that influenced organizational strategy Content-related experience, ideally with audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media Experience building relationships and running projects across multiple functions with diverse stakeholder groups

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience supporting executive reporting and business reviews, including ownership of MBR/QBR narratives or equivalent documents Demonstrated ability to drive operational excellence through process improvement, automation, or streamlining of data and business processes Understanding of data governance principles and practices, including metric definition standardization and data quality management Experience partnering with Business Intelligence Engineers or Data Scientists to apply advanced analytics techniques and unlock new data sources Ability to work a flexible schedule that occasionally accommodates US time zone meeting requirements Experience working with or supporting European markets or cross-regional teams

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

We are looking for a Creator Marketing Manager to help grow and accelerate Audible's creator ecosystem and product offerings globally. This role has an outbound focus — you'll be a storyteller, working across all external-facing channels (website, blog, paid media, SEO, email, influencer marketing, and events) to bring products together into cohesive messaging for Audible's audiences, particularly authors and narrators. You'll get exposure to both B2B and B2C audiences — working with end consumers who listen to audiobooks and the creators who produce that content.

You'll run integrated, multi-channel campaigns where all your marketing channels work together with consistent messaging and coordinated timing. You'll also build and manage the content strategies and editorial calendars that guide execution across these channels.

You'll have the opportunity to shape the future of Audible's creator products by translating the needs of authors, publishers, narrators, and other creative stakeholders into customer-centric strategies that inform technology, content partnerships, and marketing investment. Your work will surprise and delight the creators who bring content to our catalog across the globe. You'll contribute to defining our go-to-market strategy with an eye on expanding Audible's value proposition for creators, growing our content supply, and deepening relationships with the creative community that powers our catalog.

About You

You're a hands-on marketer who can flex between strategy and execution. You've run integrated campaigns across multiple channels and know how to coordinate messaging, timing, and content so everything works together — not in silos. You're comfortable building editorial calendars, writing briefs, managing paid media, and partnering with cross-functional teams to bring a product story to life.

You're a generalist and an athlete — someone who wears multiple hats and thrives in a fast-moving environment. You have a passion for data-driven results, a spirit that anything is possible, and an unapologetic focus on the customer. You thrive in a highly collaborative environment where people are driven, enthusiastic, and not afraid to take risks. Your mission (and ours) is unique: fill hearts, minds, and souls with premium audio content that entertains, informs, and enriches.

As a Creator Marketing Manager, you will...

 Define and deeply understand Audible's target audiences — both consumers and creators — and champion their needs throughout the organization Craft compelling product stories and messaging for existing and prospective customers by creating clear and consistent propositions articulated through effective messaging Run integrated, multi-channel campaigns with ownership across paid media, editorial content, email, social, SEO, and other touchpoints — ensuring consistent messaging and coordinated timing Build and manage content strategies and editorial calendars that guide multi-channel execution across website, blog, paid media, SEO, and other marketing touchpoints Partner with Product teams to understand the product story and translate it for external audiences — developing positioning and messaging that drives awareness, demand, and adoption Drive business case development, bringing together customer insights, research, financial data, and analytics to develop a perspective on revenue and profitability potential for new-to-market initiatives Partner with Finance, Analytics, and Data Science to define, measure, and report on success and opportunity areas Communicate marketing plans and campaign performance to stakeholders and leadership

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

 Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements Experience building, executing and scaling marketing campaigns from concept to completion 5+ years of experience in product marketing and business strategy Experience in growth marketing, brand marketing, or audience marketing Experience in integrated marketing — building and managing content strategies, editorial calendars, and coordinating messaging across multiple channels (website, blog, paid media, SEO, email) Experience defining and driving new customer-centric products and features toward market launch rollout Experience in always-on/evergreen marketing programs such as lifecycle, retention, or sustained product marketing Bachelors Degree

Preferred Qualifications

 B2B marketing experience Experience working with sales teams on enablement or small business marketing Experience in membership-based or subscription business models Experience in digital content, media, or audio companies Experience managing external partners to develop marketing programs Experience working with creators

campaignsBuild and maintain deep knowledge of key Premium Subscription growth levers and develop a working understanding of how those levers differ for D2C partnersLeverage analytics and insights to assess partner health, uncover optimization opportunities, and influence data-driven decisions across internal and external stakeholdersImprove and scale partner operations by identifying opportunities for additional efficiency, implementing streamlined processes, and enhancing partner tools and systemsWhat experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?6+ years of relevant experience at a technology or media company with a strong track record of building and maintaining external relationshipsDeep understanding of the U.S. streaming landscape and the content collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer.
