About This Role

As an Applied Scientist, you will solve large complex real-world problems at scale, draw inspiration from the latest science and technology to empower undefined/untapped business use cases, delve into customer requirements, collaborate with tech and product teams on design, and create production-ready models that span various domains, including Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Reinforcement Learning (RL), real-time and distributed systems.

About You

Your work will focus on inventing or adapting scientific approaches, models, and algorithms driven by customer needs at the project level. You will develop components and/or end-to-end solutions that are deployed into production or directly support production systems, delivering consistently high-quality work that meets both scientific and engineering best practices. You will develop reusable science components and services that resolve architecture deficiencies and customers’ pain points, while making technical trade-offs for long-term/short- term. You will work semi-autonomously to deliver solutions, contribute to research papers at peer-reviewed venues when appropriate, and document your work thoroughly to enable others to understand and reproduce it. Your decision-making will consistently incorporate robust, data-driven business and technical judgment. You will collaborate with other scientists to raise the bar of both scientific and engineering complexity for the team and to foster valuable scientific partnership opportunities to help/guide science decisions. We work in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where scientists, engineers, and product managers work to test and build scalable foundational capabilities, as well as customer facing experiences. You will have the opportunity to innovate and think big within your projects scope, implement optimization services and algorithms, and influence the experiences of millions of customers. We are looking for a results-oriented Applied Scientist with deep knowledge in ML, NLP, Deep Learning, GenAI, and/or large-scale distributed computation.

As an Applied Scientist, you will...

 Understand use cases across the business and adopt/extend/design/invent solutions/models that are scalable, efficient, and automated for difficult problems that are not well defined Work closely with fellow scientists and software engineers (at Audible and Amazon) to build and productionize models, deliver novel and highly impactful features Review models of peers for the purpose of reducing and managing risk to the business, while improving customer experience Design, develop, and deploy modeling techniques and solutions for Content Understanding, Recommendations, GenAI-based product features, by employing a wide range of methodologies, working from simple to complex Contribute to initiatives that employ the most recent advances in ML/AI in a fast-paced, experimental environment Push the boundary of innovation

This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

 Knowledge of data structures, algorithm design, statistics, and system design MSc + 5ys of relevant experience, or PhD +1 year in one of the following disciplines: Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math, or a related quantitative field 3+ years of experience in Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing/Understanding, GenAI and/or Reinforcement Learning Proficiency in Python, SQL, and other scripting languages Experience employing and innovating with LLMs/GenAI to solve complex problems

Preferred Qualifications

rows.title: Data Science Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

This role is for Angstrom Sports, a proprietary sports pricing and product provider, building intricate, simulation driven pricing and risk systems to support the success of key sports brands across the Entain group.

Founded in 2018 and having established itself as a pioneer in player-level, play-by-play simulations and forecasting, Angstrom was acquired by Entain in 2023. Today, we operate as a semi-autonomous division, responsible for delivering the group’s most advanced pricing and risk capabilities with a focus on the US market. We’re committed to building the next generation of sports betting products — sports-first, recreationally-focused, and designed to make betting more engaging, more intelligent, and more fun.

We’re proud to be a high-performing, low-ego team where brilliant people are empowered and people work to become brilliant. While we’re ambitious and delivery-driven, we take real pride in how we operate and the health of our independent culture, underpinned by mutual trust and respect.

Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for a talented organiser of people & projects to join our rapidly expanding Sports Analytics company based in London Bridge.

As Data Science Manager, you are responsible for managing the Leads of multiple sport-specific modelling teams. You ensure consistency, alignment, and delivery across the portfolio of models while supporting the career development of Lead Data Scientists.

You will work closely with the Head of Data Science on planning, staffing, and setting the direction for the function. You will be instrumental in scaling the data science capability and ensuring technical quality, delivery efficiency, and team cohesion across the department.

Key Responsibilities

Resource planning of the Data Scientists to optimise departmental objectives and tasks in ongoing projects.Manage, coach, and develop Data Science Leads across multiple teams.Support Leads in planning, prioritisation, and delivery of high-quality forecasting models.Help set and maintain a high bar in technical standards, code practices, and documentation across teams.Identify and address capacity, capability, or performance challenges across the department.Collaborate with Delivery and Engineering counterparts to maintain efficient team operations.Work with the Head of Data Science to shape department-wide strategy, tooling, and hiring plans.Facilitate cross-team learning, innovation, and the sharing of best practices.Act as an escalation point for technical or resourcing issues across teams.Represent the Data Science function in cross-departmental discussions or leadership meetings.Help maintain a collaborative, supportive, and high-performance culture across the modelling organisation.

Qualifications

Essential

Demonstrated success managing Data Science Leads and growing high-performing teams.Skilled in aligning delivery across multiple projects, sports, or technical domains.Strong technical background in model development and deployment, with the ability to support and challenge teams when needed.Advanced programming experience (R/Python/C#/Java)Excellent communication and leadership skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.Proven ability to manage hiring, performance, and team development.Familiar with cross-functional planning, prioritisation, and capacity management.Champions a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and delivery.Domain expertise in sports modelling or betting products.2+ years managing teams and leading delivery across multiple modelling projects

Desirable

Experience building or scaling data science functionsFamiliarity with model governance, risk, or compliance processes.Knowledge of tooling and infrastructure challenges across data and ML teams.Strategic thinking in resource allocation and modelling roadmaps.Passion for modelling excellence and deep awareness of current trends in applied data science.Experience using cloud services (AWS preferred)A degree (PhD, MSc, BSc) in a STEM subject or similar provable numerate and quantitative skills

Additional Information

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire peak performance. Join us, and a competitive salary is just the beginning.

Depending on your role and location, you can expect to receive benefits like:

Generous bonus schemeHybrid workingPrivate medical insurancePension Scheme - matched to 6%Ability to buy and sell holidayFree subscription to wellbeing app UnmindEntain & Enhance daysSharesave Scheme

Join a winning team of talented people and be a part of an inclusive and supporting community where everyone is celebrated for being themselves.

Should you need any adjustments or accommodations to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us.

rows.title: Product Manager - Customer Journey Development
rows.descriptionText:
Ready to improve how customers apply for and use lending and everyday banking products? 

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or an exciting new direction, we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We’re one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

As a Product Manager-Customer Journey Development, you’ll own the end-to-end design, delivery and optimisation of customer journeys across one or more product verticals such as Credit Cards, Personal Loans, Current Accounts and FX. Working from Discovery through to Live Performance you’ll translate customer insight, commercial objectives and regulatory requirements into journeys that are measurably better for customers and for the business. You’ll join a newly established Product and Journey Development team within HSBC UK Retail Transactional Banking with a clear focus on consistent, data-driven journey thinking. Success means clearer problem definition, better-designed journeys and measurable improvements across customer experience, operational efficiency and commercial outcomes. The role also contributes to team capability by setting standards and strengthening the way journey work is done across the function.

What You'll Be Doing

 Own end-to-end customer journey design delivery and optimisation across selected product verticals  Run structured discovery using quantitative data qualitative research and regulatory insight to define scope and root causes  Create journey problem statements and discovery packs that frame outcomes for customers commercial performance and compliance  Map current-state journeys end-to-end identifying friction drop-off and failure points using supporting data  Design target-state journeys aligned to HSBC strategy risk appetite and scheme and regulatory obligations  Define detailed journey specifications including channel flows decision logic and exception handling and manage journey-level delivery epics and stories contributing to the customer journeys delivery roadmap 

What We're Looking For

 Bring substantial experience in product management, customer journey management or service design across retail banking products such as credit cards and personal loans  Demonstrate end-to-end delivery from discovery through to live optimisation for a product or customer journey  Translate data research and regulatory requirements into clear actionable journey designs  Apply journey and service design methods including Jobs To Be Done personas journey mapping service blueprinting and experience design  Use data and analytics such as funnel performance NPS and commercial and operational MI to form insight-led hypotheses  Partner across Product Risk Legal Compliance Operations and Technology and navigate governance and steering forums 

 Opening up a world of opportunity 

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com .

rows.descriptionText:
As a Lead Pricing Data Analyst within the Data & Analytics team, you’ll play a key role in shaping the pricing strategy for Barclaycard Payments’ . You’ll combine data-driven insight with commercial understanding to support pricing decisions that drive growth, profitability, and customer value. Working closely with stakeholders across Product, Finance, Commercial, and Analytics teams, you’ll help develop and refine pricing approaches that ensure the business remains competitive in a dynamic payments market.

You’ll be responsible for the creation, development, and maintenance of pricing models, using deep analysis of customer behaviour, transaction trends, and competitor activity to generate actionable insights. You’ll lead performance reviews of pricing initiatives, monitoring outcomes and identifying opportunities for optimisation. With strong stakeholder engagement skills, you’ll also oversee model governance activities, ensuring pricing methodologies are robust, well-controlled, and clearly documented. This is a highly visible role where your ability to translate complex data into meaningful commercial recommendations will directly influence the success of Barclaycard Payments’ pricing strategy.

Barclays’ payments acceptance business provides critical infrastructure to the UK economy, processing billions of pounds of payments annually for both small businesses and domestic and international corporate clients.

In April 2025, we announced a long-term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve-outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long-term growth.

Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance-linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long-term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments (BPL) brand and acting as the sole payments acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years.

For more information on our partnership with Brookfield, please visit Barclays.com.

rows.title: Senior Data Governance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Purpose of Role:
The Senior Data Governance Analyst helps shape how trusted data is governed and used across Baillie Gifford.
You will take ownership of one or more core Data Governance areas:
- Governance by Design, Data Products & Technology Enablement- Federated Ownership, Data Quality & Adoption- Enterprise Governance, Risk & Assurance
You will lead colleagues within your sub-team, strengthen data ownership and quality, and embed practical governance across Data Products, modern data platforms, analytics and AI-enabled change. Substantial Data Governance experience, sound judgement and stakeholder influence are essential.
Responsibilities:
Portfolio Leadership and DeliveryLead one or more core Data Governance areas, setting priorities, maintaining a roadmap and tracking risks, dependencies and outcomes.Lead governance work from problem definition through implementation and adoption, coordinating business and technology colleagues.Build trusted stakeholder relationships, make proportionate recommendations and escalate material issues early.Governance Framework and Embedded DeliveryDevelop and embed practical governance policies, standards and controls, translating them into procedures and decision routes teams can apply consistently.Embed governance requirements in Data Products, change initiatives, modern data platforms, analytics and AI-enabled use cases, including input to data models and integrations.Shape governance tooling and automation where processes and accountabilities are clear.Data Quality, Ownership and AssuranceStrengthen Data Owner and Data Steward accountability, supporting decisions on definitions, quality, access and remediation.Define scalable data-quality rules and thresholds, lead complex investigations and agree proportionate fixes with accountable owners.Produce reporting and assurance evidence showing whether governance is working and where action is required.Leadership and Continuous ImprovementLead your sub-team to deliver agreed priorities, review work quality and build capability through coaching and meaningful ownership.Maintain repeatable methods, clear documentation and effective cross-cover, using management information and feedback to improve outcomes.
What Success Looks Like:
Clear ownership and delivery across your Data Governance area, with predictable engagement routes, prioritised outcomes and useful measures.Governance that is easier to apply, with practical standards and timely support reducing uncertainty, rework and avoidable escalation.Improved ownership and trust in priority data, with visible quality rules, issues, decisions and remediation.A resilient, capable sub-team with reusable methods, strong documentation and effective cross-cover.
Your Knowledge and Experience:
Substantial hands-on Data Governance experience, with expert knowledge of governance frameworks and developing and applying policies, standards and controls.Strong knowledge of data ownership, data quality, metadata and lineage.Practical understanding of data models, databases, integrations, reporting and the data lifecycle.Experience with governance, metadata or data-quality tooling such as Informatica, Collibra, Talend Data Fabric or equivalent.Understanding of Data Products and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, including how governance is embedded across their lifecycle.Working knowledge of DAMA-DMBOK principles and their application to Data Governance and Data Management.Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives, with strong planning and delivery-management skills.Able to investigate issues across multiple data sources or systems, define quality rules and thresholds, and drive resolution.Experience creating reporting, controls or assurance evidence to support decision-making.Able to manage competing priorities effectively.Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.Experience influencing governance adoption and helping stakeholders embed new ways of working.Confident influencing senior stakeholders and explaining complex requirements in practical language.Experience leading and mentoring colleagues, reviewing work and establishing repeatable methods.CDMP certification or another recognised Data Management or Data Governance qualification (Preferred)Analytics or AI Data Governance experience. (Preferred)Restricted or licensed data controls. (Preferred)
The type of candidate that we’re looking for:
You’ll be an experienced Data Governance professional who combines strong technical knowledge with a practical, collaborative approach. You’ll be comfortable working across business and technology teams, turning governance requirements into clear, workable solutions and helping stakeholders embed good data practices. You’ll also be confident managing competing priorities, influencing senior colleagues and driving improvements across data quality, ownership, metadata and controls.
Critical Skills:
Data LiteracyNurture relationshipsAdaptabilityDigital effectivenessImprovement mindsetSystems thinking
Closing Date: September 19, 2026
Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives.
At Baillie Gifford, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful culture in which each of our colleagues can thrive and develop. We believe that our clients are best served by a diverse workforce with the experiences, ideas and perspectives that this brings.
If you are currently working at Baillie Gifford as an employee or contractor please apply to this job from the firm's Workday internal career site.

About The Role

Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. rows.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Content and Contributor Intelligence (Remote - United States)
rows.descriptionText:
Summary

Yelp engineering culture is driven by our values: we’re a cooperative team that values individual authenticity and encourages creative solutions to problems. All new engineers deploy working code their first week, and we strive to broaden individual impact with support from managers, mentors, and teams. At the end of the day, we’re all about helping our users, growing as engineers, and having fun in a collaborative environment.

Yelp’s mission of connecting people with great local businesses requires the use of cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to scale across a vast and diverse base of users and businesses spanning various geographical locations. As a Staff-level ML Engineer on the Content Contributor Intelligence team, you will help build connections across millions of users and business listings. Your work will involve using cutting-edge industry tools, including neural networks (NNs), large language models (LLMs), and various embedding techniques for text, images, and videos. Additionally, you will apply traditional ML methods such as XGBoost and linear models to enhance our systems. You’ll be responsible for turning raw data into valuable signals and building ML systems end-to-end. This includes the full ML lifecycle from training models to deploying them in production, as well as contributing to the ML platforms these models rely on.

This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular state within the US. We welcome applicants from throughout the US. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

What You'll Do

Conduct end-to-end analyses, wrangling data via SQL or Python, to statistical modeling, to hypothesizing and presenting business ideas.Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and technical excellence.Work with large and complex textual and visual datasets.Support the development and deployment of projects involving machine learned models for offline, batch-based data products as well as models deployed to online, real-time services.Work in the contributor and visual intelligence team on text and visual understanding, along with fine tuning transformer models to derive embeddings for multiple input typesProductionize and automate model pipelines within Python services.Drive and advocate adoption of best practices in ML development and operations, and mentor newer engineers in those practices.

What It Takes To Succeed

Experience developing and productionizing machine learning models, particularly in neural networks, computer vision and LLMs including their supported data pipelines.Experience with machine learning using packages such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark MLlib, XGBoost, and Sklearn.Strong coding skills in Python or equivalent (Java, C++).Solid understanding of engineering and infrastructure best practices.The curiosity to uncover promising solutions to new problems, and the persistence to carry your ideas through to an end goal.We highly value experience of working with LLMs, utilizing LLM APIs (OpenAI, Bedrock, etc), prompt engineering and evaluation.A Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent work experience is required

What You'll Get

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience. Based on the anticipated level of experience we are seeking, we expect the compensation range for this role to be between $112,000 and $269,000. You may also be offered a bonus, restricted stock units, and benefits.This opportunity has the option to be fully remote in all locations across the US.You can find more information about Yelp's five star benefits here!

Closing

At Yelp, we believe that diversity is an expression of all the unique characteristics that make us human: race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, and education — and those are just a few. We recognize that diverse backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our teams and our product. The foundation of our diversity efforts are closely tied to our core values, which include “Playing Well With Others” and “Authenticity.”

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition or disability.

Actual salary offered may vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to, an individual's location and experience. 

We will consider for employment qualified candidates with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable law (including, for example, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for roles based in San Francisco, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for roles based in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County, and the California Fair Chance Act for roles based in California).

Where required by law, a criminal background check will not be conducted until after a conditional offer of employment is made, and any evaluation of a candidate's criminal background check will be subject to an individualized assessment that takes into account the candidate's specific criminal records and the responsibilities and requirements of the particular role.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations-recruiting@yelp.com or 415-969-8488.

Note: Yelp does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to any recruiting alias or employee. Yelp is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Our commercial organization supports a diverse portfolio of merchants, ranging from strategic Enterprise partners to thousands of small and medium-sized businesses. Successfully serving both requires a combination of high-touch relationship management and scalable commercial programs.

We're looking for a Commercial Program Manager who will directly own a portfolio of Enterprise merchant relationships while also leading programs that improve how we support, engage, and grow our long-tail SMB business.

About The Role

As a Commercial Program Manager, you will operate across two critical areas of our commercial organization: Enterprise Account Management and SMB Program Management.

You will directly manage a select portfolio of Enterprise merchants, owning the commercial relationship, business performance, and long-term growth strategy for those partners. You'll develop joint business plans, identify growth opportunities, lead business reviews, navigate operational challenges, and work cross-functionally to strengthen each partnership.

At the same time, you will lead programs designed to improve how Uber manages thousands of SMB merchants at scale. Rather than directly managing the SMB long tail, you'll build and optimize the programs, processes, segmentation strategies, reporting, automation, and commercial playbooks that enable Account Managers and Account Coordinators to effectively manage large books of business.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong commercial and relationship-management skills with structured program management, analytical thinking, and operational problem solving. Success requires the ability to move seamlessly between strategic merchant conversations and building scalable solutions for a complex commercial organization.

What You'll Do

 Enterprise Account Management & Growth - 30%

Develop joint business plans focused on growing sales, improving operational performance, and strengthening long-term partnerships.  Identify and execute growth opportunities across promotions, advertising, merchandising, product adoption, and other commercial levers. Lead commercial conversations and negotiations while balancing merchant objectives with Uber's broader business priorities.  Partner cross-functionally across Operations, Product, Marketing, Sales, and other teams to resolve merchant challenges and unlock growth. 

 SMB Program Management & Commercial Strategy - 45%

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.  Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence both external partners and internal cross-functional stakeholders.

Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, retail, grocery, restaurants, last-mile delivery, SaaS, or another technology-enabled commercial environment. rows.descriptionText:
About Team

At Uber, we're not just moving people and things; we're building a global business grounded in integrity. Our Financial Risk Management (FRM) Advisory team is the backbone of that integrity, ensuring our financial reporting is accurate, trustworthy, and compliant with the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX).

As a Senior on this team, you'll be on the front lines, safeguarding our financial data and helping us navigate the complexities of a dynamic, global company. This isn't just about checking boxes-it's about asking the right questions, acting with conviction, and boldly improving our processes to drive meaningful outcomes and maintain the trust of our stakeholders.

What You Will Do

Uber's technology platform reimagines the way people and things move in cities around the world by connecting drivers, riders, and eaters. We offer a variety of services including:

Ridesharing: Connecting riders with drivers for convenient transportation. Delivery: Connecting consumers with restaurants and stores for food, groceries, and other deliveries. Freight: Connecting shippers and carriers in the logistics space. 

Job Responsibilities - FRM Advisory Senior - Business Process

Strategic Risk Advisory & Governance: Serve as the lead advisor to business process owners in the orchestration and maintenance of a robust internal control environment. This includes championing the integration of risk management principles-including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance-throughout the end-to-end project lifecycle to ensure risk mitigation is embedded into business operations by design. Control Evaluation and Monitoring: Conduct end-to-end evaluations of internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR) to ensure the integrity and accuracy of financial disclosures. This responsibility entails executing risk diagnostics, assessing the design and operational effectiveness of controls, mapping key financial statement assertions to control activities, and monitoring the effectiveness of controls. Process Enhancements and Optimization: Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the organization. rows.title: Sr Product Manager - Enterprise Risk
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Product Manager, Enterprise & Payment Risk

About The Role

Uber's Risk team is critical to enabling trusted growth across our global marketplace by preventing fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Enterprise (B2B) accounts are a major and fast-growing part of that marketplace, and managing their risk is one of the most structurally complex domains in Payment Risk.

In this senior, high-impact individual contributor role, the Product Manager for Enterprise & Payment Risk will own the full risk lifecycle of B2B entities at scale - from onboarding and information acquisition, through manual review processes, to real-time risk decisioning at checkout and payment. The role also owns the underlying account and billing infrastructure that enterprise risk decisions run on, and the recovery/verification experiences enterprise customers rely on when something goes wrong.

A defining challenge of this role is that the enterprise customer base spans many distinct cohorts, each with a different risk tolerance and a different sensitivity to friction and actioning. Success requires calibrating risk treatment differently across these cohorts rather than applying a single, one-size-fits-all policy - balancing fraud prevention against growth and satisfaction for legitimate business customers. This is the most stakeholder-intensive scope in the Payment Risk organization, requiring close, sustained partnership with business/BD leadership in addition to Engineering, Data Science, and platform teams.

This position is ideal for a senior product leader who thrives in ambiguous, high-stakes problem spaces, has strong command of B2B/enterprise payment or billing systems, and can drive outcomes through influence across a large and often-competing set of stakeholders and shared engineering capacity.

What The Candidate Will Do

Own the B2B entity risk lifecycle end-to-end at scale: onboarding and information acquisition, manual review workflows, and real-time risk decisioning at checkout and payment. Segment and calibrate risk policy across distinct enterprise customer cohorts, each with different risk tolerance and sensitivity to friction/actioning. Define the product requirements and roadmap for enterprise risk capabilities, including underlying account and billing infrastructure modernization and its associated cross-functional dependencies. Own recovery and verification experiences for enterprise customers, including fallback challenges, admin verification, and cross-party messaging. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to scope and land payment authorization and decisioning improvements against concrete loss-reduction targets. Triage, prioritize, and negotiate a high volume of cross-functional dependency requests against shared and constrained engineering capacity. Build and maintain trusted relationships with business/BD stakeholders, translating enterprise account needs into a risk product roadmap. Measure impact using well-defined KPIs (e.g., loss-rate reduction, authorization effectiveness, dispute/chargeback rates) and iterate based on learnings. Coordinate with Risk Operations, Risk Governance/Compliance, and payments platform teams to ensure solutions are practical, compliant, and operationally sound. 

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of product management experience delivering software products as an individual contributor in a technology company. Experience owning a complex, technically deep product domain (e.g., payments, billing, risk, or platform infrastructure) with significant stakeholder breadth. Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform decisions and measure impact. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex problems simply to both technical and business audiences. Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Business/BD, Design, and Operations, including negotiating priority against shared/constrained resources. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data/Analytics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience). 

Preferred Qualifications

Risk & Fraud Domain Expertise - Experience in risk, fraud, or trust & safety within a B2B/enterprise or multi-sided marketplace, particularly billing risk, checkout/payment decisioning, or auth-hold systems. Demonstrated success partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations partners to deploy algorithms into production. A successful candidate should have experience in marketing and possess strong analytical skills, and attention to detail.  Execute email deployments from setup through launch, ensuring campaigns are delivered accurately, on time, and aligned with business priorities. When initiatives and programs are supported through EIS, you and your team will collaborate with many other stakeholders while also driving participation and utilization through innovation, technology, data-driven decision making, and automation. Job Description

Our Opportunity:

Chewy is seeking a customer-obsessed, analytically rigorous Senior Manager, Healthcare Media Planning to shape and execute the media strategy for our growing healthcare retail business. Based in Boston, MA, this role will translate business objectives and customer insights into integrated, full-funnel media plans that build awareness, drive consideration, and accelerate customer growth for our healthcare retail categories of Pharmacy and Vitamins & Supplements.

You will own media strategy and planning across channels such as OTT, paid social, paid search, affiliate, and emerging platforms. Working closely with Marketing, Channels, Finance, Analytics, and Creative teams, you will recommend how we invest, whom we reach, where we reach them, and which messages are most effective in order to drive our business and consumer objectives.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with deep media-planning expertise. You know how to translate audience insights and performance data into clear investment recommendations, develop integrated plans for channel teams to activate, and identify opportunities to test new approaches. You are equally comfortable shaping a long-range media roadmap, evaluating media-mix scenarios, and using campaign results to guide future planning and optimization.

What You'll Do

What You'll Need

Job Description

Our Opportunity:

Chewy is seeking a highly motivated and strategic Senior Financial Analyst to join our Corporate Finance Business Partnerships team as a Finance Business Partner supporting enterprise G&A functions! In this highly visible role, you will help steward payroll and G&A expenses, translate executive and functional priorities into financial plans, and provide trusted, data-driven insights to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. You will support budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, monthly reporting, and strategic analysis across areas including headcount, professional fees, business matters, settlements, insurance, software, and other corporate costs. This role operates with meaningful autonomy and judgment. Success requires a detail-oriented self-starter who can independently frame problems, build scalable financial mechanisms, operate at depth, and communicate clear recommendations in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.

What You’ll Do

Serve as a Finance Business Partner for enterprise G&A functions, providing trusted, data-driven financial partnership and guidance to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.Steward payroll and G&A expenses across the supported functions, with ownership of key performance indicators and mechanisms that drive accountability to financial targets.Translate business strategies and executive priorities into financial plans, tradeoffs, and actionable recommendations, while proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and dependencies.Own and maintain detailed financial models for headcount and payroll, professional fees, business matters, settlements, insurance, software, and other corporate expenses.Support target setting and annual, quarterly, and rolling forecast processes by developing assumptions, evaluating business drivers, and influencing prioritization through clear financial insights.Lead monthly close and management reporting activities, including variance analysis, accrual support, forecast updates, and preparation of accurate, timely, and decision-relevant executive summaries.Create inspection mechanisms for budgets, forecasts, headcount, and actual results to improve forecast accuracy, financial visibility, data quality, and accountability to plan.Partner with functional stakeholders to improve planning and reporting across key spend categories, including professional services, business matters, settlements, insurance, and other corporate expenses.Provide ad hoc financial analysis and decision support for strategic initiatives, investment requests, cost optimization opportunities, and organizational changes. Develop standardized reporting and dashboards that translate complex financial data into actionable insights and ensure consistent communication with business partners and stakeholders.Drive continuous improvement and automation across reporting structures, close processes, governance, and planning mechanisms to increase efficiency and scalability.Extract, reconcile, and analyze data from central systems and databases using tools such as Hyperion SmartView, Oracle ERP, Tableau, Excel, and SQL.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.3+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Finance Business Partnering, Accounting, or a related analytical role, with an understanding of GAAP and financial statements.Advanced analytical and financial modeling skills, including demonstrated experience building complex models from the ground up and working with large, detailed datasets.Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables, scenario modeling, and large-data analysis; strong PowerPoint and data visualization skills.Experience with budgeting, forecasting, headcount and payroll analysis, key performance indicators, variance analysis, and financial controls.Confidence interacting with senior business leaders and the ability to distill complex analyses into clear, concise insights and recommendations for senior and executive audiences.Strong influencing, written, and verbal communication skills, with sound business judgment and the ability to build effective working relationships and drive data-backed decisions.Ability to independently navigate ambiguity by framing problems, setting priorities, and driving analytical work forward in the absence of established templates or clear precedent.

Bonus

MBA, CPA, or other relevant advanced degree or certification.Experience supporting executive or corporate functions.Familiarity with an e-commerce or retail business model.Experience with Hyperion SmartView, Oracle ERP, Tableau, SQL, or similar financial and analytical tools.Experience improving or automating financial reporting and planning processes.

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Description & Requirements

We are a team of technologists that provides Functional Integration solutions as a product to our clients across various financial institutions, as well as software infrastructure within Bloomberg. Our team is part of the Enterprise Products Platform (EPP) group, with a special domain focus on facilitating machine-to-machine interaction between our clients’ systems and the products Bloomberg offers. Our clients are primarily financial institutions in the capital markets, and the Bloomberg products they typically use include market data, trading systems, portfolio solutions, and risk analytics.

Functional Integration solutions are among the most commonly used software offerings in EPP, as they serve as the primary systems for transferring bulk data files between our clients’ applications and Bloomberg analytics. The files processed by these systems contain business-critical financial data such as clients’ positions, transactions, private securities, and pricing information. The number of files handled daily is very large and growing rapidly. Therefore, one of the main goals of the engineering team is to provide stable and scalable backend systems leveraging cloud-based object storage, distributed systems, and microservice architecture. There is also a strong focus on full-stack development so that we can provide sophisticated user interfaces to our customers, as well as web-based tooling for the Bloomberg Enterprise Service team to support clients’ complex workflows involving data mapping, data enrichment and overrides, encryption, and decryption.

Our technologies

We Develop Our Software Using a Combination Of Open-source, Third-party, And In-house Technologies. As Engineers, We Strive To Balance Selecting The Best Technology For a Problem With Managing The Risks Of Using Exploratory Technologies. Some Of The Problem Domains We Regularly Encounter Are

Distributed systemsBulk data processingUser interface developmentService-oriented architecture

Some of the specific technologies we use today include Python, C++, React, and PostgreSQL.

Our values

Technical Excellence: Strive for the highest standards in the quality of our work, whether in design, development, support, or testing.Customer Focus: Ensuring a consistent and high-quality experience for our customers is essential.Ownership: Take on a problem and own the solution from start to finish; our success comes from the actions we take.Collaboration: The best designs are created when we work together.Open-Mindedness: We believe in always being open to new ideas and learning.

How we work

We are a self-organizing and collaborative team with a high degree of influence over our project roadmap, and you’ll benefit from working closely with other experienced engineers and product counterparts. We work in two-week sprints and plan our projects in six-sprint product increments.

What is the role?

As a senior engineer on the team, you are expected to understand the problems faced by our stakeholders and customers; collaborate with teammates and business partners to develop requirements; and turn those requirements into high-quality technical solutions. Beyond this core aspect of the role, we also expect senior engineers to be mentors, helping to hire, develop, and support other engineers on the team. rows.descriptionText:
About Startpage

Startpage is System1's flagship privacy technology brand, serving millions of users worldwide with private search and browsing experiences built around privacy, trust, and user choice.

Founded in the Netherlands and built on privacy-by-design principles, Startpage has grown into one of the world's leading privacy-focused search platforms. Today, Startpage is a profitable, scaled global consumer internet business with meaningful revenue, EBITDA, and a loyal international user base.

As consumers become increasingly aware of how their data is collected and used online, Startpage is uniquely positioned to become the trusted alternative for users seeking a safer, more private web experience.

The Opportunity

Search is undergoing its most significant evolution in decades. Advances in AI are changing how consumers discover information, how platforms compete for attention, and how digital businesses create value.

Startpage is uniquely positioned to capitalize on these shifts as a trusted privacy-first alternative serving millions of users worldwide.

We are seeking a General Manager to lead the next phase of Startpage's growth by expanding our user base, strengthening our brand, accelerating product adoption, deepening user engagement, and driving profitable growth.

The successful candidate will understand how emerging technologies, including AI, are reshaping consumer behavior and will help ensure Startpage continues to innovate while remaining true to its privacy-first mission.

This role is ideal for a consumer internet operator who has successfully scaled digital products through growth, product marketing, partnerships, and operational excellence. You should be equally comfortable discussing acquisition economics, retention cohorts, brand positioning, distribution strategy, monetization, and product priorities.

You will operate with an owner mentality, running Startpage as a standalone business while leveraging the scale, resources, and infrastructure of System1.

Core Mandate

 Accelerate global user growth, engagement, user retention, activation, and lifetime value Strengthen Startpage's position as the leading privacy-focused search and browsing platform Expand distribution through strategic partnerships and platform integrations Grow revenue and profitability through disciplined product and commercial execution Build a world-class consumer growth organization across product, marketing, analytics, and partnerships

This position is an onsite role requiring you to work in our headquarters located at 4235 Redwood Ave. Los Angeles, CA 90066.

Business Leadership & P&L Ownership

 Own the overall operating plan, strategy, and financial performance of Startpage. Drive sustainable growth in users, engagement, revenue, and profitability. Allocate resources effectively across growth functions and competing opportunities Identify and execute new opportunities for expansion and long-term value creation. Operate with founder-level accountability and ownership.

Growth, Marketing & User Acquisition

 Own global user acquisition, activation, retention, and engagement metrics. Lead cross-functional growth initiatives spanning product, marketing, analytics, and partnerships. Scale acquisition channels while improving efficiency and return on investment. Drive lifecycle marketing programs that improve retention and user lifetime value. Build a culture of experimentation and data-driven decision making. Expand Startpage's reach across key international markets.

Product Strategy & Consumer Experience

 Define and execute the product strategy for Startpage's search and browsing experiences. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders to deliver compelling consumer experiences that drive acquisition, engagement, and retention. Champion the voice of the customer across all product decisions. Ensure product investments align with business objectives, user needs, and brand positioning. Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, including AI-powered search and discovery, where they can improve user experiences while preserving Startpage's privacy-first values.

Search & Market Evolution

 Monitor changes in search, browsers, AI-assisted discovery, and consumer behavior. Evaluate emerging technologies and partnerships that can strengthen Startpage's competitive position. Help shape Startpage's long-term strategy as search and AI continue to converge. Ensure Startpage remains relevant as the search ecosystem evolves while maintaining its commitment to privacy and transparency.

Partnerships & Distribution

 Expand distribution through strategic partnerships with browsers, OEMs, publishers, privacy-focused platforms, and other ecosystem partners. Identify, negotiate, and manage high-impact commercial relationships. Develop new channels for user acquisition and business growth. Strengthen Startpage's position within the broader privacy and consumer technology ecosystem.

What Success Looks Like (24–36 Months)

 Sustained growth in DAU, MAU, and search volume Increased user retention and engagement Expanded global distribution footprint Stronger brand awareness and consideration among privacy-conscious consumers Successful introduction and adoption of new search and discovery experiences that strengthen Startpage's competitive position in an evolving search landscape Improved monetization and unit economics Continued growth in revenue and EBITDA Strengthened market position as the leading privacy-first alternative in search

Required

What You’ll Bring:

 8+ years of experience building and scaling consumer internet businesses. Experience leading growth and/or product marketing for a consumer product at scale. Demonstrated success driving user acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue growth. Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing, consumer acquisition, monetization, partnerships, and brand development. Experience managing meaningful business metrics and operating plans, ideally with direct P&L responsibility. Ability to partner effectively across product, engineering, marketing, analytics, and commercial teams. Strong strategic thinker with a bias toward execution and measurable results. Passion for consumer products and delivering outstanding user experiences.

Preferred

 Experience with search, browsers, consumer subscriptions, digital media, marketplaces, or other scaled consumer internet businesses. Experience leading international consumer products. Experience overseeing both product and growth organizations. Familiarity with how AI is influencing consumer search, discovery, content, or digital experiences. Interest in privacy, trust, and consumer technology.

Ideal Candidate Background

Successful candidates often come from leadership roles within consumer internet businesses such as:

 Search and browser platforms Consumer subscription businesses Digital media companies Creator and content platforms Privacy-focused technology companies Consumer productivity and utility products

Why This Role Is Unique

A profitable, scaled consumer internet business with millions of users worldwide.The opportunity to shape the future of privacy-first search as search and AI continue to evolve.Significant autonomy and direct P&L ownership.The resources and infrastructure of System1 combined with the agility of an independent business.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Location

New York

Business Area

Engineering and CTO

Ref #

10049958

Description & Requirements

What we do

Bloomberg is the global leader in financial data, analytics, and technology. Our products power the workflows of financial professionals across research, trading, portfolio management, and risk.

At the centre of this is BQuant. BQuant reimagines the Bloomberg experience by putting code at its core - it brings together the cutting edge of our Data, API, and AI strategies to enable unprecedented customization and time-to-value for our code-aware users, and in a manner that is instantly available. These users can quickly analyze and combine Bloomberg’s extensive financial data and analytics with their own, to build models and workflows that span the entire investment lifecycle, and easily make these available to any other user at their firm.

Your Role

As Product Lead for the Data User Experience, you will define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the core data and analytics experience within BQuant.

You will be responsible for how users discover, access, understand, and work with data, enabling them to combine Bloomberg data with proprietary datasets to power research, trading and AI applications - with confidence and trust.

Your customers will include both end users and internal teams building workflow-specific solutions on top of the platform, such as backtesting and trading systems integrations. You will also serve as the primary liaison to Bloomberg’s data-producing teams, and will work closely with Engineering, Quants, and other product managers to ensure the platform enables a wide range of use cases, from exploratory research to production-grade applications.

What You’ll Do

Define the Data User Experience

Set the vision and own the execution for the end-to-end data experience in BQuantOwn the roadmap and backlog, taking into account external and internal customer input, product strategy, value propositions, competitor analysis and operational requirementsBalance short-term improvements with long-term platform scalability

Build a Scalable Data Analytics Platform

Ensure data can be easily integrated, enriched, and combined with client dataDefine and evolve API abstractions for using financial and alternative datasetsEnsure data is provisioned with appropriate SLAs, reliability, and performanceEnable support for different workflows using batch and streaming dataDrive consistency in how data is modeled, accessed, and used across the platformEnsure robust handling of entitlements, security, and data governance

Enable Quantitative and Data Intensive Workflows

Support workflows across research, backtesting, and production deploymentEnable users to generate signals and analytics from combined datasetsPartner with teams building solutions on top of the data platformEnsure the platform supports multi-asset and complex financial data use casesEnable users to trust data across the full lifecycle from experimentation to production

Collaborate Across Bloomberg

Act as the primary liaison with data-producing teams to onboard new datasetsPartner with Engineering, UX, and other product teams to deliver cohesive solutionsBalance the needs of internal platform users and external clients

What We’re Looking For

Product Strategy & Execution

Proven ability (5 yrs+) to define and execute product strategy for platform productsExpert prioritization skills balancing user needs, technical constraints, and business impactExperience delivering complex products from concept through execution

Data Platform Expertise and Innovation

Strong experience building or leading data platforms or analytics infrastructureGood understanding of data access patterns, APIs, and data modelingExperience working with large-scale datasets, including time series and streaming dataPractical experience applying AI/ML to solve customer problems, with a strong understanding of how to translate emerging capabilities into product strategy and measurable outcomes

Partnership & Communication

Deep experience working closely with engineering teams on technical platform productsExcellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholdersStrong collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Quants, and business teams

Quantitative & Data Workflow Understanding

Understanding of workflows across research, analytics, and tradingExperience enabling users to combine multiple datasets and generate insightsFamiliarity with challenges in moving from research to production systemsExperience addressing data quality, entitlements, security, and governance challenges

Salary Range = 140,000 - 295,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

rows.title: Sales Operations Junior Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.

From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.

10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.

But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.

If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.

Find us on Instagram: @optimizely

Introduction 

Optimizely is seeking a Sales Operations Analyst, Conversation Intelligence to join our GTM Operations team.

Every day, Optimizely generates thousands of recorded customer conversations — discovery and negotiation calls, onboarding and implementation sessions, QBRs and renewal discussions, support interactions, and AI-agent exchanges. Individually they are anecdotes. Systematically captured, tagged and routed, they are the most honest signal we have about why we win, why we lose, why customers churn, and what the market actually wants from us.

This role exists to build that system. You will own how conversation data is captured, structured and turned into decisions across the revenue organization — starting with seller performance and deal health, and extending across the full customer lifecycle.

This is a build role, not a reporting role. You will be the connective tissue between Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding & Services, Enablement, Marketing, Product and our Operations, Technology, Data & Analytics team.

Job Responsibilities

What You’ll Own

 The conversation data foundation

⚬ CI Strategy & Roadmap: Execute Zoom Revenue Accelerator (ZRA) strategy across Sales, CS, and Onboarding.

⚬ Signal Taxonomy & Routing: Build a cross-functional signal taxonomy and routing logic to direct insights to owners.

⚬ Data Quality & Capture Strategy: Track recording coverage, establish quality thresholds, and manage tooling capture strategies.

 Sales execution and performance

⚬ Workflow Transformation & Auditing: Integrate transcript insights into key deal milestones and use Salesforce data to audit deal stages and forecast accuracy.

⚬ Methodology Adherence & Performance: Build scorecards to measure sales methodology on live calls and surface coaching insights.

⚬ Productivity & Win/Loss Program: Scale top-performing rep behaviors and run a win/loss program to identify cycle friction.

 Retention, onboarding and expansion

⚬ CS & Onboarding Workflows: Operationalize CI across adoption, onboarding, risk identification, and renewals.

⚬ Risk & Health Signals: Define early risk indicators to feed health scores and alert CSMs early.

⚬ Expansion Detection: Surface cross-sell opportunities for Optimizely One and route qualified signals to CSMs/sellers.

 Cross-functional intelligence

⚬ Competitive & Pricing Insights: Provide evidence on competitors, objections, and discount triggers to PMM, Deal Desk, and Finance.

⚬ Product & Messaging Feedback: Extract feature requests for Product and deliver ICP/messaging evidence to Marketing.

⚬ Enablement & Risk Flagging: Measure post-enablement behavior, flag off-script commitment risks, and create process docs.

 Platform and AI operations

⚬ Platform & Prompt Management: Build, test, and maintain AI prompt frameworks (e.g., ZRA, LLMs) and optimize the CI tech stack.

⚬ Product Fluency: Maintain functional knowledge of our Opal platform and apply internal AI capabilities to GTM ops.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, you will demonstrate:

⚬ Expanded Coverage: Measurable conversation coverage across Revenue with shrinking blind spots.

⚬ Methodology Impact: Documented methodology adherence that correlates with higher win rates.

⚬ Forecast Accuracy: Improved forecast accuracy via conversation-validated deal stages.

⚬ Proactive CS Signals: Early risk and expansion signals delivered to CS and Onboarding.

⚬ Cross-Functional Trust: A recurring intelligence readout consumed outside Revenue.

Behavioral Expectations

⚬ Process-First Mindset: Strong project management background to build scalable AI workflows in a fast-paced environment.

⚬ Outcome-Oriented: Prioritize work aligning with company objectives and business outcomes.

⚬ Cross-Functional Influence: Operate comfortably across boundaries to align non-direct-report teams.

⚬ Accountability & Problem-Solving: Blameless mindset focused on transparency and preventative solutions.

⚬ Self-Driven Innovation: Continuously experiment, research, and self-teach emerging AI/CI tools.

⚬ Curious & Transparent: Curious about GTM AI tech, maintaining clear communication and healthy work/life balance.

Knowledge And Experience

2+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Process Strategy, ideally at a SaaS company Conversation intelligence and AI tool fluency: hands-on experience with conversation intelligence platforms (e.g. Zoom Revenue Accelerator, Gong, Clari, Chorus) and modern GTM AI tools, including large language models and prompt engineering Analytical acumen: comfortable turning qualitative conversational data and AI outputs into clear, actionable metrics for leadership Taxonomy and data structuring instinct: able to impose consistent structure on unstructured, messy conversational data Cross-functional delivery: experience running programs that span Sales, CS and other functions Experience with Salesforce or a comparable enterprise CRM 

Education 

Bachelor’s degree or related educational degree or certificates

Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Connect to your IndustryDeloitte's Engineering practice is at the forefront of transforming businesses by bringing together cutting-edge tech programme delivery, quality assurance, and testing expertise. We empower clients to modernise their core business through our deep capabilities in application and infrastructure engineering, cloud strategy, transformation, and migration. Practitioners within this team continuously advance their expertise to deliver robust, innovative solutions, from initial strategy to implementation and optimization.
When Deloitte and AWS partner together, through collaboration, innovation and trust, we help organisations achieve meaningful change and reach their full potential. With our one team approach, we combine our extensive capabilities, industry knowledge and cutting-edge AWS technology to create transformative solutions that have a tangible impact for our clients.
Join a team that is not only recognised for its leadership but is actively shaping the future of AWS-enabled solutions.
Connect to your career at Deloitte Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact.These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.
Connect to your opportunityHow do you shape the future of organisations navigating one of the most significant technological shifts of our time? That’s exactly what you’ll do in this role. As an Associate Director, you’ll build trusted relationships with business stakeholders – and use the most exciting new AWS technologies available – to create data-driven programmes that transform their organisations. Your advice will help clients position their organisations to succeed in an ever-evolving marketplace.Lead the architectural design and implementation of robust, scalable, secure, and cost-effective AWS Cloud solutions across various industries and client environments.Translate complex business requirements into detailed technical designs and architectural blueprints, ensuring alignment with client objectives and Deloitte's best practices.Provide expert technical guidance and leadership to project teams, overseeing the successful delivery of AWS engagements from inception to completion.Collaborate closely with clients, Deloitte engagement teams, and AWS representatives to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance of cloud solutions.Develop and maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor on AWS Cloud strategy and implementation.Contribute to the continuous improvement of Deloitte's AWS capabilities, methodologies, and intellectual property.Mentor and develop junior architects and engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.Stay abreast of the latest AWS developments, industry trends, and emerging technologies to ensure Deloitte remains at the forefront of cloud innovation.
Connect to your skills and professional experienceYou’re a natural at taking initiative. Someone who brings out the best in others and is a brilliant listener. You’ll grow our business without compromising standards, integrity, or culture. We’re all about letting our leaders lead, so we’ll give you the breathing space you need to do so’.
EssentialsKey consulting skills, with a deep focus on AWS cloud transformation, AI enablement and generative AI adoption, including a number of the following:Extensive experience in cloud architecture, with a significant focus on designing and implementing solutions on AWS.Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale, complex AWS projects across various domains (e.g., data analytics, application modernisation, infrastructure, security).Experience working in a technical pre-sales capacity, producing bid documentation, RFIs, RFPs and participating in technical bid presentationDemonstrable ability to provide well-considered, clearly articulated and pragmatic AWS-based solutions and recommendations to complex business and technology challenges.Proven ability to prioritise workload, meet project deadlines and drive successful delivery outcomes across AWS-enabled programmes.Ability to communicate complex AWS architecture, engineering and migration topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.Management of teams, workstreams and deliverables across cloud strategy, migration, modernisation and platform engineering engagements.AWS service, partner and product assessment and selection, including evaluation of fit-for-purpose cloud-native and third-party capabilities.Assessment of applications for technical suitability, migration approach and modernisation opportunities on AWS.Ability to identify, shape and communicate practical AI and generative AI opportunities using AWS services, with clear consideration of business value, risk, governance and operational readiness.Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive and results-oriented approach.Understanding cloud security and compliance best practices.
For a full job description, please visit our online Deloitte Careers portal.

supportability of cloud solutions.Drive the adoption of cutting-edge Google Cloud technologies, including services like Gemini Enterprise, to enhance client capabilities and foster innovation.Collaborate closely with clients, Deloitte engagement teams, and Google Cloud representatives to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance of cloud solutions.Contribute to the technologies to ensure Deloitte remains at the forefront of cloud innovation.

rows.title: Senior Statistician
rows.descriptionText:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.

From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.

10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.

But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.

If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.

Find us on Instagram: @optimizely

Introduction

Rigorous statistical analysis is a core to all experimentation products at Optimizely. You will get on customer calls to articulate how we maintain statistical accuracy in our products as well as triage questions around statistical inference. You will educate internal and external stakeholders about fundamental as well as cutting edge statistics concepts via webinars, speaking engagements, blog posts, and white papers. You will also have the opportunity to work with our product and engineering teams to build new statistics/ML features for all of Optimizely’s products. You will have also have the opportunity to partner with experts in academia and research to explore and identify the latest trends and next great innovations that Optimizely should invest in.

Job Responsibilities

Product and Feature Development

Collaborate with product managers and engineering teams to design and implement new statistical and machine learning features across Optimizely’s product suite. Conduct rigorous testing and validation of new statistical methods and ensure seamless integration into the platform. Analyze product performance data to optimize existing features and provide actionable recommendations for improvement. Leverage AI agents to deploy new statistical capabilities. 

Research and Innovation

Partner with academic and industry researchers to explore cutting-edge statistical methods and machine learning innovations. Identify emerging trends in experimentation and statistics that could enhance Optimizely’s offerings. Propose and prototype advanced statistical techniques to solve challenging business problems faced by customers. 

Quality Assurance and Compliance

Develop and enforce statistical standards and best practices for all experimentation processes. Monitor and evaluate statistical algorithms to ensure accuracy, reliability, and scalability. Provide internal stakeholders with guidance on statistical compliance and methodologies to safeguard the credibility of experiment results. 

Education and Thought Leadership

Develop and deliver educational content on statistics, including webinars, blog posts, white papers, and public speaking engagements. Simplify complex statistical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences to promote understanding of experimentation best practices. Represent Optimizely at conferences and industry events, showcasing expertise in experimental design and statistical analysis. 

Customer Engagement and Support

Conduct customer calls to explain how statistical accuracy is maintained across Optimizely’s experimentation products. Triage and resolve customer inquiries related to statistical inference and experimentation methodologies. Assist customers in designing statistically valid experiments tailored to their needs and objectives. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with sales, customer success and onboarding teams to offer statistical expertise during customer onboarding and key engagements. Serve as a statistical advocate within the organization, fostering a culture of rigorous data-driven decision-making. Collaborate with marketing teams to showcase Optimizely’s statistical capabilities in external communications. 

Knowledge And Experience

3+ years of industry or educating experience with experimentation, data science, analytics, etc. Understanding of and ability to explain experimentation, randomized control trials, and inference, particularly aspects of high throughput testing such as multiple hypothesis testing, sequential testing, reinforcement learning, robustness, data mining of experiments Demonstrable experience of at least one of the following subjects: Classical statistical inference (fixed horizon tests, sequential tests); Bayesian statistical inference; Causal inference (potential outcome framework, randomized controlled trials, observational studies) and experiment design; Reinforcement learning (e.g., multiarmed bandit). Demonstrable working experience of python and SQL, (knowing R is also helpful). Experience collaborating on applied statistical research or designing commercial statistical features/applications Experience with AI applications 

Education

Advanced degree in Statistics, Computer Science or a closely related field such as bioinformatics, econometrics, economics or applied mathematics

Competencies

Communicating Effectively

Driving Continuous Improvement

Driving for Results

Interacting with People at Different Levels

Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.
